# Indiana governor bans trans athletes in women's sports, honors SJSU athlete who alleges lost scholarship
---
| | **Fox News ** **Jackson Thompson**
**March 4, 2025 ** [https://www.foxnews.com/sports/indiana-gov-bans-trans-athletes-girls-sports-honors-sjsu-athlete-who-lost-scholarship-blaire-fleming](http://links.email.in-gop.com/s/c/MtSFCnceCJJFSVjLadO4feqHUqtnKtOAvfPv7Q7KmeAm_vQCPPwnKIKD71MK2hY6uX2I2kVLPLfXctj2okP07AmfFeOrqwW0FPjFGtY87Fad8VLg412wkooBm0WfDKK4vRTZv6S9BAPqUlxNp5WhqWcpx9ICAGmNs3tqQecbWMO1t698BimaCti9oAQaildlemtAtVM-ZxIacamIVtsTTVU9aSVCCYTntUGoTyy-Blld_5xXjS8-kyjz7ksbCdczmjb_QJa7PhLb0uYeLFUlXG3kaWfmEG-rmp6pOE7_20XbsSS95hkvNwvLDzo7rJsnB4lKQR6EEul0gIdNZBaBRCvGxdCnTxrVa04a-0NOmM_9RpkAK2TDz5j2TcFtoXwrwif_ZJ6CX3DcC8Cxp68/n-Aijw7H39aCj72agbYVdGue7bZ0qjYH/6) Indiana Gov. Mike Braun signed an executive order Tuesday to prohibit transgender athletes from competing in women's college sports. He was joined by former San Jose State University volleyball player Elle Patterson, who claims she lost out on a scholarship to a trans athlete. Braun said his order ensures fairness in women’s sports in a news release. "Women’s sports create opportunities for young women to earn scholarships and develop leadership skills," Braun said. "Hoosiers overwhelmingly don’t want those opportunities destroyed by allowing biological males to compete in women’s sports, and today’s executive order will make sure of that." The order states, "This executive order mandates that Indiana’s state educational institutions must comply with the 2020 Title IX Rule rather than the 2024 Biden Administration reinterpretation that extended protections based on self-reported, ever-changing new idea of ‘gender identity.’ "The order ensures that female athletes in college sports are not forced to compete against biological males, preserving the integrity of women’s athletics and protecting opportunities for women in female-only sports leagues." Braun then signed another executive order that "rejects extreme gender ideology in favor of the scientific reality of biological sex" by reinforcing Indiana’s legal definitions for "sex," "gender," "women," "male," "citizen," "individual" and "person." "Today’s executive order will end any confusion about our state’s policy on this issue so we can focus on my goal to secure freedom and opportunity for all Hoosiers," Braun said after signing the second order. Braun honored Patterson during the signing. Patterson joined a lawsuit against SJSU and the Mountain West Conference in November with 10 other conference players and one former assistant coach over its handling of transgender player Blaire Fleming. Patterson alleges the university did not fulfill previous verbal offers of a scholarship to her for the 2023 and 2024 seasons. Patterson says she even paid full tuition to play in 2023 after being told she would get a scholarship for 2024. However, the program did not make good on that offer either, she alleges, while Fleming got a full scholarship. "Ultimately, Patterson informed Associate Head Coach Batie-Smoose and Head Coach Todd Kress that she was financially unable to pay for full out-of-state tuition, room and board at SJSU again in 2024 and therefore would be unable to return to the SJSU Team without a scholarship," the documents state. "Nevertheless, Todd Kress remained firm in his position that Patterson would not receive a scholarship to play on the SJSU Team in 2024, and that Fleming would receive a full scholarship to play on the SJSU Team." Braun expressed sympathy for Patterson during his address Tuesday. "It's just wrong, and leaders need to stand up for young women like Elle," Braun said. "We need to protect their physical safety and the great opportunities that come with that athletic excellence." The order comes just one day after the U.S. Senate failed to pass the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act. Despite getting 51 votes by the Republican majority, Democrats filibustered the bill with 45 votes against it. President Donald Trump signed an executive order to prohibit transgender athletes from competing in women's sports Feb. 5. However, some Democrat-led states have so far refused to comply with the order. Braun has taken steps to ensure that does not happen in his state, joining Idaho Gov. Brad Little, who signed a similar executive order in August.

_As promised, we are amping up our call to DOGE to help audit America’s voter rolls. Our country has several key elections coming up in 2025 - and a massive number of elections in 2026 (36 Governor’s races!). The time to have this conversation is ... right now._

Dear Department of Governmental Efficiency (DOGE),
From Social Security Administration (SSA) records, to IRS fraudulent filers, to USAID funding schemes and more, your work has exposed rampant inefficiencies and inaccuracies within federal databases.
These revelations should prompt critical examinations of other essential systems, particularly our voter registration databases.
Accurate voter rolls are fundamental to the integrity of our electoral process. However, studies have highlighted challenges in maintaining up-to-date records. A 2012 report by the [Pew Center on the States ](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.UJcOIEsxQ3qr5lEWJDDC4s9AZEmzTA4nDpBPgTbHyOf9Dji49Xq5nuOsg9hF5U_htZ5cXfpnqmbDxMf5LFvJkTg1IHhm94ki60JPSQ1P_0wW02nprdShYbYlaJMXGH7sA9kwkPm3Z91rDZyzAq1uUUd47SAR30CXdRWeFRtFtPVMwctBN00J2k7ANLx-IHm8TkyK9cuHDz4pY96H-E7PnXJaiQH94xCXm56dwAvA22jNAoujnDPF0WWq1Smd6uitKchsSDfSqJ_lbvcQVO51-ecwJF0FKn5ZSF5FskSznxeh88xXydkNio3ceQ1rF4XanFmWSNlwyTODGEGY44XVqSTJZFJxhO-6DCO2AD4TCYsTHzYEkTF89EkSDiOSvLLzYICc39uNfly9NgaUW4IOzDZIi8dWuf0u18kfacmQVYJF5haS6lULboOqxsLG4kGzna88zPA98w9bq4A7H4V8vA/4ek/WGAPn0AUQHSsd-b0I4DXtw/h3/h001.nL6C8U_0QY-ZYujGzoEIsnL3lR3x_V_qqM36qpwQZ1M)found that approximately 24 million voter registrations in the United States—one in every eight—are either no longer valid or contain significant inaccuracies. In 2024, [True the Vote’s research](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.ZOvxkEhKDw9DETb6Ummm9zQuo-zt7v1AcpXkOLMbvNt6YrZM562R3uGahNjwIn7jkGt_IWnw-uSgtquK_mdpjjdISa-tLImUGCjFLnGJ8wgupnIYbZgfrKgSBZWzU_Zdi29iXFWB1SJxnJoAh4VHMIahz4DIC2C8CHq5oYzWqZE944vwHkgDsuZZgE9m3EWYZV_6IYqXXAR2x80nFNZWr_FlckpJS-s8UaNEjc9Sg4WEo4RLAFM3cgsiJQC9HI2l/4ek/WGAPn0AUQHSsd-b0I4DXtw/h4/h001.DzTylZHWpz4NE0TJSvYMKWKgaLYgOdCxcFSJ8TsfPLw) identified over 25 million inaccuracies based on residency alone. The situation is getting worse, not better.
Given DOGE's mandate to enhance governmental efficiency and your recent insights into federal data discrepancies, we urge you to extend your investigative rigor to the nation's voter registration systems. This initiative would not only bolster public confidence in our electoral processes but also ensure that electoral outcomes accurately reflect the will of the electorate.
True the Vote stands ready to assist in this effort. We have already aggregated and normalized state voter roll data, cross-referenced against multiple sources, and made our code available on GitHub for transparency. Our experience in election integrity research and our ability to provide structured, actionable data make us an ideal partner in this mission. By combining DOGE’s access to federal databases with our assembled voter roll information, we can efficiently identify discrepancies and work toward a cleaner, more reliable election system.
Elections are the cornerstone of our republic. The American people expect accuracy, transparency, and accountability. DOGE has the tools and the access. Audit the voter rolls. Restore trust in our elections. The time is now.

clean_body: Tonight, before Trump even speaks, Congresswoman Lateefah Simon will set the record straight — no spin, no BS. Tune in at 8:30 PM ET / 5:30 PM PT. | | | Peter — After attacking Social Security, cutting funding for cancer research, and firing air traffic controllers that keep our skies safe — now billionaire Elon Musk has his sights set on an open Wisconsin Supreme Court seat. On April 1, voters in Wisconsin will head to the polls to vote in a critical election that will determine the balance of power for the state’s Supreme Court. Whomever is elected, whether that be Democrat Susan Crawford or MAGA extremist Brad Schimel, will become the deciding vote on future cases before the court — including cases impacting collective bargaining, reproductive rights, and voting rights in the next 2 years. Already, a group backed by Elon has dropped $1.6 million on misleading ads to prop up Brad Schimel, 1 a far-right extremist who believes insurance companies should be allowed to deny health care coverage to those with pre-existing conditions. Now it’s up to us to show Elon that our democracy is not for sale. It’s no wonder why Elon has taken such a strong interest in the Wisconsin Supreme Court election. After spending $250 million to elect Trump in 2024, Elon was given free rein to slash federal programs and fire any federal worker he felt like, even if he didn’t completely understand what he was cutting or who he was firing. Now he’s spending millions in local races like the Wisconsin Supreme Court — undoubtedly he is expecting a return on his investment. We can’t just sit by while the seats of government and justice are sold off to the highest bidder. That’s why we’re ramping up our organizing — knocking on doors, texting and phonebanking voters in the lead up to the April 1 election. But we can’t fight back against Elon’s millions without the support from our supporters like you, Firstname. And every contribution to Fair Fight helps push back against voter suppression and support candidates who’ll ensure equal access to the ballot box.

| Peter,

Last night, in his first joint address to Congress, Donald Trump proudly touted his so-called “accomplishments” since taking office. **Among them?_Slashing our federal workforce, killing Virginia jobs, and imposing devastating tariffs on our allies – and Virginia’s closest trading partners._**

These actions aren’t just a threat to Americans throughout our country – they’re a direct attack on Virginians – nonpartisan public servants who have devoted their careers to protecting our communities and keeping Virginia safe. On top of that, Trump’s unprovoked trade war with two of Virginia’s largest trading partners, Canada and Mexico, is going to drive up prices and hurt our economy – no one wins in this situation.

Yet, what is Virginia’s leadership doing in the face of this crisis? **Absolutely nothing.** Our current Governor and Lieutenant Governor (my opponent) are standing by Trump’s agenda, even praising him for these harmful actions. They’ve both even praised his speech on social media today.

As Virginians continue to lose their jobs, face rising costs, and see fewer opportunities for working families, we need a leader who will stand up for Virginia – not for special interests and not for partisan politics.

body:
Last night I gave the official response to Trump’s speech - here's what I said.
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/87599?t=6&akid=19138%2E878179%2EuoVmO-) Hi everyone. Senator Elissa Slotkin here.

Last night I gave the official response to President Trump’s Joint Address. I hope you had a chance to watch.

Since I’m a stranger to most people who don’t follow politics, I introduced myself and just kept it straight with the people watching about the moment we are in right now.

We just went through another fraught election season. Americans made it clear that they want change. But there is a responsible way to make change, and a reckless way. And, we can make that change without forgetting who we are as a country, and as a democracy.

Because no matter where you live, most Americans share three core beliefs: That the middle class is the engine of our country. That strong national security protects us from harm. And that our democracy, no matter how messy, is unparalleled and worth fighting for.

We all know that our country is going through something right now. We’re not sure what the next day is going to hold, let alone the next decade.

But this isn’t the first time we’ve experienced this as a country. Every single time, we’ve gotten through those moments because of two things: Engaged citizens and principled leaders.

If you're with me in that fight, I have an ask of you:

[Can you split a contribution between my campaign and Voter Protection Project to help us elect a new generation of leaders who put country first? »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/87599?t=7&akid=19138%2E878179%2EuoVmO-) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Elissa Slotkin and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/87600?t=8&akid=19138%2E878179%2EuoVmO-)

Thank you for watching (if you did) and for donating today.

Elissa

body:
The President’s joint address to Congress last night was filled with partisan attacks, blatant lies, and alarming threats to our democracy.
# [](https://act.robbonta.com/go/3?refcode=em20250305&t=1&akid=1676%2E1088799%2EY-c1Ck)
Donald Trump’s joint address to Congress last night was filled with partisan attacks, blatant lies, and alarming threats to our democracy.
The President continued to make false claims about the 2020 and 2024 elections, directed ugly attacks at immigrants and the LGBTQ+ community, and bragged about repealing diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts, cutting billions of dollars in life-saving federal aid that helps people both here and abroad, and more.
It’s also important to note what Trump _didn’t_ talk about last night, like the skyrocketing costs of living for working families that are about to get even worse under his tariffs, the federal workers being hurt by DOGE cuts and mass firings, and the seniors, veterans, children, and other vulnerable communities losing crucial services.
**Instead of making our lives better, this administration would rather dismantle the government and move us backward for the benefit of billionaires and far-right interests.**
But know this: I have sued Trump, Elon Musk, and the rest of their MAGA administration multiple times in these first 44 days of Trump 2.0, and I will continue to do so if and when they break the law and trample on your liberties again.
**No matter what Trump says or thinks, the United States is not a nation led by kings.** He has the same powers as the presidents who came before him — any time he tries to unlawfully exceed that power, I will take action.
**[With four years of this administration ahead of us, will you fuel our ongoing work to hold Trump accountable and keep our state and country moving forward by pitching in $5 now?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-20250305?refcode=em20250305-1676&amount=5&refcode2=1676_1088799_Y-c1Ck&akid=1676%2E1088799%2EY-c1Ck)**

In solidarity,
Rob

* **TOP NEWS**

"**US Rep. and former Houston mayor Sylvester Turner dies at 70** ," AP's **Juan A. Lozano** -- "Democratic U.S. Rep.**Sylvester Turner** of Texas has died two months after taking office and hours after attending President **Donald Trump 's** address before Congress in Washington, D.C., officials and his family said on Wednesday. He was 70.

While attending Trump's speech to Congress, Turner was taken to a hospital and later released, Turner's family said in a statement.

Turner's family said that at 5:45 a.m. Wednesday, "he died at his home from enduring health complications."

The family did not offer additional information on those health complications. In November 2022, Turner revealed he had undergone treatment, including surgery and radiation therapy, earlier that year for bone cancer in his jaw.

"Congressman Turner was the consummate public servant. But to us, he was our beloved father, grandfather, sibling and relative. Thank you for your prayers," the family said in its statement.

"The House Democratic Caucus family is shocked and saddened by the sudden passing of Congressman Sylvester Turner. Though he was newly elected to the Congress, Rep. Turner had a long and distinguished career in public service and spent decades fighting for the people of Houston," House Democratic leader **Hakeem Jeffries** said in a statement.

Before being elected to Congress, Turner served as Houston's mayor for two terms.

During Wednesday's Houston City Council meeting, Mayor **John Whitmire** announced Turner's death, saying it "comes as a shock to everyone."
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/a1cc3fe9-d32b-46c8-b6cd-1c7713fb47cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"I've lost a personal friend, advisor, and we've lost an outstanding public official," Whitmire said.

Before Trump's speech Tuesday night, Turner had posted a video on social media introducing his guest for the speech, a mother from Houston, and telling the current administration, "Don't mess with Medicaid."

Whitmire said he was told that during Trump's speech Tuesday evening, Turner didn't feel good, went home and was later taken to the hospital.

Whitmire said he saw Turner on Saturday at the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo parade and he "looked fine."

In a statement, Texas Gov. **Greg Abbott** called Turner "a man of character who served his fellow Texans for more than 36 years."

"Congressman Turner leaves behind a legacy of service to our great state," Abbott said.

Turner was elected in November, filling the Houston seat that had been held by longtime U.S. Rep. **Sheila Jackson Lee** , [who died last July](https://substack.com/redirect/eedbd35e-bf2c-4f22-ad3b-ab50a0f91320?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) after being diagnosed with pancreatic cancer.

Turner served eight years as Houston's mayor, leading the nation's fourth-largest city through various challenges, including devastating flooding from [Hurricane Harvey](https://substack.com/redirect/2d5a2831-1621-489e-a3a4-b4c5901bdf9b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in 2017.

Before being elected as mayor, Turner served 27 years in the Texas House of Representatives. ...

Turner was born and raised in Houston's Acres Homes, a historic Black neighborhood. He earned degrees from the University of Houston and Harvard Law School before working as a trial lawyer and later founding his own law firm. He was elected to the Texas House in 1988 and served for nearly three decades before being elected Houston mayor in 2015.

"Sylvester never forgot where he came from. So, that will be my memory of him. I also will always remember he could light up a crowd," Whitmire said." [AP](https://substack.com/redirect/39133707-b1b4-4224-bfc0-658139606863?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Lozano -- "Democratic U.S. Rep.Sylvester Turner of Texas has died two months after taking office and hours after attending President Donald Trump 's address before Congress in Washington, D.C., officials and his family said on Wednesday. He was 70. While attending Trump's speech to Congress, Turner was taken to a hospital and later released, Turner's family said in a statement. Turner's family said that at 5:45 a.m. Wednesday, "he died at his home from enduring health complications." The family did not offer additional information on those health complications. In November 2022, Turner revealed he had undergone treatment, including surgery and radiation therapy, earlier that year for bone cancer in his jaw. "Congressman Turner was the consummate public servant. But to us, he was our beloved father, grandfather, sibling and relative. Thank you for your prayers," the family said in its statement. "The House Democratic Caucus family is shocked and saddened by the sudden passing of Congressman Sylvester Turner. Though he was newly elected to the Congress, Rep. Turner had a long and distinguished career in public service and spent decades fighting for the people of Houston," House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries said in a statement. Before being elected to Congress, Turner served as Houston's mayor for two terms. During Wednesday's Houston City Council meeting, Mayor John Whitmire announced Turner's death, saying it "comes as a shock to everyone." "I've lost a personal friend, advisor, and we've lost an outstanding public official," Whitmire said. Before Trump's speech Tuesday night, Turner had posted a video on social media introducing his guest for the speech, a mother from Houston, and telling the current administration, "Don't mess with Medicaid." Whitmire said he was told that during Trump's speech Tuesday evening, Turner didn't feel good, went home and was later taken to the hospital. Whitmire said he saw Turner on Saturday at the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo parade and he "looked fine." In a statement, Texas Gov. Greg Abbott called Turner "a man of character who served his fellow Texans for more than 36 years." "Congressman Turner leaves behind a legacy of service to our great state," Abbott said. Turner was elected in November, filling the Houston seat that had been held by longtime U.S. Rep. Sheila Jackson Lee , after being diagnosed with pancreatic cancer. Turner served eight years as Houston's mayor, leading the nation's fourth-largest city through various challenges, including devastating flooding from in 2017. Before being elected as mayor, Turner served 27 years in the Texas House of Representatives. ... Turner was born and raised in Houston's Acres Homes, a historic Black neighborhood. He earned degrees from the University of Houston and Harvard Law School before working as a trial lawyer and later founding his own law firm. He was elected to the Texas House in 1988 and served for nearly three decades before being elected Houston mayor in 2015. "Sylvester never forgot where he came from. So, that will be my memory of him. I also will always remember he could light up a crowd," Whitmire said." "**US Rep. and former Houston mayor Sylvester Turner dies at 70** ," AP's **Juan A. Lozano** -- "Democratic U.S. Rep.**Sylvester Turner** of Texas has died two months after taking office and hours after attending President **Donald Trump 's** address before Congress in Washington, D.C., officials and his family said on Wednesday. He was 70.

While attending Trump's speech to Congress, Turner was taken to a hospital and later released, Turner's family said in a statement.

Turner's family said that at 5:45 a.m. Wednesday, "he died at his home from enduring health complications."

The family did not offer additional information on those health complications. In November 2022, Turner revealed he had undergone treatment, including surgery and radiation therapy, earlier that year for bone cancer in his jaw.

"Congressman Turner was the consummate public servant. But to us, he was our beloved father, grandfather, sibling and relative. Thank you for your prayers," the family said in its statement.

"The House Democratic Caucus family is shocked and saddened by the sudden passing of Congressman Sylvester Turner. Though he was newly elected to the Congress, Rep. Turner had a long and distinguished career in public service and spent decades fighting for the people of Houston," House Democratic leader **Hakeem Jeffries** said in a statement.

Before being elected to Congress, Turner served as Houston's mayor for two terms.

During Wednesday's Houston City Council meeting, Mayor **John Whitmire** announced Turner's death, saying it "comes as a shock to everyone."
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/5aa34793-c831-4fa6-907d-9ea9867dab16?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"I've lost a personal friend, advisor, and we've lost an outstanding public official," Whitmire said.

Before Trump's speech Tuesday night, Turner had posted a video on social media introducing his guest for the speech, a mother from Houston, and telling the current administration, "Don't mess with Medicaid."

Whitmire said he was told that during Trump's speech Tuesday evening, Turner didn't feel good, went home and was later taken to the hospital.

Whitmire said he saw Turner on Saturday at the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo parade and he "looked fine."

In a statement, Texas Gov. **Greg Abbott** called Turner "a man of character who served his fellow Texans for more than 36 years."

"Congressman Turner leaves behind a legacy of service to our great state," Abbott said.

Turner was elected in November, filling the Houston seat that had been held by longtime U.S. Rep. **Sheila Jackson Lee** , [who died last July](https://substack.com/redirect/84c22d47-8909-42a7-9cf8-d4be8b3b4a4e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) after being diagnosed with pancreatic cancer.

Turner served eight years as Houston's mayor, leading the nation's fourth-largest city through various challenges, including devastating flooding from [Hurricane Harvey](https://substack.com/redirect/bd724cc3-de08-4cea-b6b0-f687f47a1ed7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in 2017.

Before being elected as mayor, Turner served 27 years in the Texas House of Representatives. ...

Turner was born and raised in Houston's Acres Homes, a historic Black neighborhood. He earned degrees from the University of Houston and Harvard Law School before working as a trial lawyer and later founding his own law firm. He was elected to the Texas House in 1988 and served for nearly three decades before being elected Houston mayor in 2015.

"Sylvester never forgot where he came from. So, that will be my memory of him. I also will always remember he could light up a crowd," Whitmire said." [AP](https://substack.com/redirect/9fb76d3d-a49b-42a0-a783-c8b06cf27e3f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Lozano -- "Democratic U.S. Rep.Sylvester Turner of Texas has died two months after taking office and hours after attending President Donald Trump 's address before Congress in Washington, D.C., officials and his family said on Wednesday. He was 70. While attending Trump's speech to Congress, Turner was taken to a hospital and later released, Turner's family said in a statement. Turner's family said that at 5:45 a.m. Wednesday, "he died at his home from enduring health complications." The family did not offer additional information on those health complications. In November 2022, Turner revealed he had undergone treatment, including surgery and radiation therapy, earlier that year for bone cancer in his jaw. "Congressman Turner was the consummate public servant. But to us, he was our beloved father, grandfather, sibling and relative. Thank you for your prayers," the family said in its statement. "The House Democratic Caucus family is shocked and saddened by the sudden passing of Congressman Sylvester Turner. Though he was newly elected to the Congress, Rep. Turner had a long and distinguished career in public service and spent decades fighting for the people of Houston," House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries said in a statement. Before being elected to Congress, Turner served as Houston's mayor for two terms. During Wednesday's Houston City Council meeting, Mayor John Whitmire announced Turner's death, saying it "comes as a shock to everyone." "I've lost a personal friend, advisor, and we've lost an outstanding public official," Whitmire said. Before Trump's speech Tuesday night, Turner had posted a video on social media introducing his guest for the speech, a mother from Houston, and telling the current administration, "Don't mess with Medicaid." Whitmire said he was told that during Trump's speech Tuesday evening, Turner didn't feel good, went home and was later taken to the hospital. Whitmire said he saw Turner on Saturday at the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo parade and he "looked fine." In a statement, Texas Gov. Greg Abbott called Turner "a man of character who served his fellow Texans for more than 36 years." "Congressman Turner leaves behind a legacy of service to our great state," Abbott said. Turner was elected in November, filling the Houston seat that had been held by longtime U.S. Rep. Sheila Jackson Lee , after being diagnosed with pancreatic cancer. Turner served eight years as Houston's mayor, leading the nation's fourth-largest city through various challenges, including devastating flooding from in 2017. Before being elected as mayor, Turner served 27 years in the Texas House of Representatives. ... Turner was born and raised in Houston's Acres Homes, a historic Black neighborhood. He earned degrees from the University of Houston and Harvard Law School before working as a trial lawyer and later founding his own law firm. He was elected to the Texas House in 1988 and served for nearly three decades before being elected Houston mayor in 2015. "Sylvester never forgot where he came from. So, that will be my memory of him. I also will always remember he could light up a crowd," Whitmire said." [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Project%202025%20presents.jpg]
Six weeks back in the White House, Trump and MAGA are wielding every bit of power to dismantle democratic processes for their own benefit , while weaponizing the rule of law to attack any communities who he and his loyalists deem as threats to their divisive agenda – particularly Black and Latino communities. His absurd joint address to Congress Tuesday night further confirmed this. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/trump-address-nation-amid-sagging-approval-ratings/story?id=119390771]
WATCH Trump's full speech for yourself here. [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=E1oCr6apOKs]
We can't let his full-on gaslighting go unchecked. Now is the time to take a breath and lock in for the fights ahead. Don't tune out.
No matter what we look like or where we come from, each and every one of us deserves elected leaders who will defend our democracy and fairly govern with integrity. Any public official who lies to us, stokes violence and division, and refuses to take responsibility for the harm they are causing is unfit to represent us.
TOP’s commitment to building real political power in Texas remains steadfast. Donald Trump’s return to power only strengthens our resolve to fight even harder for the Black and Latino Texans who fuel our state.
TOP honors Women's History Month
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%202025%20Women%27s%20History.jpg]
Women inspire, women lead, and women manifest. We have been the backbone of every movement for societal progress over the course of history.
Founded and led by women, TOP every day lifts up the legacies of freedom-fighting women, especially Black and Latina women, whose vision and commitment to justice move us closer to our North Star of full liberation — women like Jovita Idar [https://www.womenshistory.org/education-resources/biographies/jovita-idar] and Fannie Lou Hamer [https://www.womenshistory.org/education-resources/biographies/fannie-lou-hamer] .
We’re here to reimagine what is possible, transform the world, win a better future for ourselves and our loved ones, and we’re not stopping.”
No amount of petty, backwards policy will hold us back from our collective desire as women to pour into our families, our communities, and lead our best lives.
Each and every one of us — regardless of the color of skin, the language we speak, or where we call home — has the power to be a catalyst for groundbreaking change, and it is our organizing that empowers new generations of women to contribute in powerful ways and fully realize their dreams.
Remembering a longtime Houston public servant
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Sylvester%20Turner.jpg]
As a champion for Houstonians for decades, the staff and members of TOP are saddened to hear of the passing of Congressman Sylvester Turner.
From the Texas House, to City Hall, to the halls of Congress, Sylvester Turner fought day in and day out for the fundamental rights of all of his constituents and fellow Texans.
The Congressman's advocacy for voting rights, affordable housing, healthcare access, and climate justice has positively transformed our Houston communities, and his legacy will be felt by future generations.
We extend our heartfelt condolences to his family, friends, and all impacted by his more than 35 years of public service to Houston and our state as a whole.

Dallas County TOP housing justice campaign meet-up
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Dallas%20housing%20justice%202024.jpg]
TOP's Dallas County Housing Justice campaign is gearing up to have a bigger impact this year to protect the rights of local tenants.
Join us at our next campaign meeting on March 19 from 5 - 7 p.m. at the Dallas TOP office (3910 Gaston Ave., Ste. 250) where we'll break bread and plan out our campaign organizing efforts for the coming months.

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%202025%20Women%27s%20History.jpg]

Recordando a un servidor público de Houston
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Sylvester%20Turner.jpg]
Como defensor de los habitantes de Houston durante décadas, el personal y los miembros de TOP están tristes por la noticia del fallecimiento del congresista Sylvester Turner.
Desde la Cámara de Representantes de Texas hasta el Ayuntamiento y los pasillos del Congreso, Sylvester Turner luchó día tras día por los derechos fundamentales de todos sus electores y compañeros tejanos.
La defensa del congresista por el derecho al voto, la vivienda asequible, el acceso a la atención médica y la justicia climática ha transformado positivamente nuestras comunidades de Houston, y su legado se sentirá en las generaciones futuras.
Extendemos nuestras más sinceras condolencias a su familia, amigos y todos los afectados por sus más de 35 años de servicio público a Houston y a nuestro estado en su conjunto.

La campaña de TOP por la Justicia en la Vivienda en el Condado de Dallas se está preparando para tener un mayor impacto este año para proteger los derechos de los inquilinos locales.

name: hear.com
subject: Hearing aids just got their biggest upgrade...
body:
Why this tiny German hearing aid is taking the U.S. by storm, according to the experts

| [](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z2jl7716t8ugf7frkoq52de8jg2ed0d4rj1utdao_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c9im1o73c1h2bs)
---
| Why this tiny German hearing aid is taking the U.S. by storm, according to the experts
---
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zuel3h8rv5vq0li7bkpm67pe68lkfkcc7u9ncb4g_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c9im1o73c1h2bs)
**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's [hear.com's](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zdvakodesof9g03e83t7dlt8446uj5qr5fh9huo0_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c9im1o73c1h2bs) **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **[hear.com's](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z3bspi1aggkg7pf0vhot52imm5oe22c8fle2ue20_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c9im1o73c1h2bs) IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.
[Check if you qualify](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z2o22pddq992upnbfoatvcto2vtsj4rumvru5os8_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c9im1o73c1h2bs)
[](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zbag3hbhgkcksecmcknl95rn98ubm0mc873or1hg_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c9im1o73c1h2bs)
What makes [hear.com's](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2ze0u0immmfm7ug22nmketdi869mpjeka217u3tp8_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c9im1o73c1h2bs) IX hearing aid so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that [hear.com's](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zbq7nrpv9kcqa96bq69mr29hdt4kvg4nhvh6hdlg_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c9im1o73c1h2bs) IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

I'm committed to protecting the promise of Virginia, where every child can get a world-class education, every business can thrive, and every family can live in safety and prosperity.

But I didn't expect the rush of enthusiasm that's swept across our campaign. _**From the bottom of my heart, thank you for being part of this movement.**_ Your encouragement, your volunteer hours, and your generous financial support are the fuel that will propel us ever forward.

Now, I need to ask for your help again. Winsome Sears

body:
Why this tiny German hearing aid is taking the U.S. by storm, according to the experts

| [](https://e.realamericanreporting.com/rd/9z2zlb5q8c9g2vb9l4bt6iajl9jva7s60d941u2dcbo_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c9hm0or2clh2bs)

| Why this tiny German hearing aid is taking the U.S. by storm, according to the experts
---
[](https://e.realamericanreporting.com/rd/9z2z5t6k9895a736rh180pdpd89lh8hpgkf7fp02cfo_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c9hm0or2clh2bs)
**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's [hear.com's](https://e.realamericanreporting.com/rd/9z2zkdfbccuctuk4ia9s9h98oig1qh5e2gtdk9o0nso_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c9hm0or2clh2bs) **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **[hear.com's](https://e.realamericanreporting.com/rd/9z2zj508daah1b63ln2mf2rona5k6pqgoui073prv1o_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c9hm0or2clh2bs) IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.
[Check if you qualify](https://e.realamericanreporting.com/rd/9z2za4s2unrbtfgimbdohig5ll2s4se8vsd834if240_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c9hm0or2clh2bs)
[](https://e.realamericanreporting.com/rd/9z2zp5sis2qu82c5hok78k1bi8mt7h35hh6n11k7jq8_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c9hm0or2clh2bs)
What makes [hear.com's](https://e.realamericanreporting.com/rd/9z2zr10f4pgf37eese54s7ednt97r3dg7hk00nbkmag_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c9hm0or2clh2bs) IX hearing aid so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that [hear.com's](https://e.realamericanreporting.com/rd/9z2zj3u9tc7kksltup83qv87967kesns5ol00sd47lg_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c9hm0or2clh2bs) IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It's not just about volume,” explains [hear.com's](https://e.realamericanreporting.com/rd/9z2zps9n4ukmm1vapdlau2i6rh9pi33v8mb6g1943n0_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c9hm0or2clh2bs) founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

_**"If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." **_
My father instilled those words of wisdom in me, and I've lived by them ever since.

Peter, I'm Vivek Ramaswamy, and I'm not just talking about my own success. I'm talking about the future of our great state of Ohio. Born and raised in Cincinnati, I've spent my life building businesses, creating jobs, and fighting against the woke agenda.

The radical Left and their media allies have taken notice, dubbing me _"The C.E.O. of Anti-Woke."_

**But I'm not done yet. I'm just getting started.**

As Governor, I'll bring the same bold leadership I showed as a CEO to the statehouse. I'll fight for a state where merit matters, free speech reigns, and We the People are in charge. No more mediocrity. No more victimhood. No more excuses.

But I need your help to make it happen. I'm not some cookie-cutter politician who only cares about climbing the political ladder. I'm also not beholden to special interests, mega-donors, or the Establishment.

Because of that, my campaign is fueled by everyday folks like you doing what they can to help. Sometimes that means kicking in a few bucks. Sometimes more. Regardless of the amount, I would be deeply honored if you'd be willing to pitch in and help my campaign keep running through the finish line.

Your support - no matter what the amount - would be a huge help.

**[So will you join me with a contribution today? Every dollar is a declaration of independence from the status quo.](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.-xYFt8w2Q "So will you join me with a contribution today? Every dollar is a declaration of independence from the status quo.")**

I'm not fighting for some cheap campaign slogan - I'm fighting for the future of our state, and our country along with it. I'm also fighting for the state where my wife, Apoorva, and I are raising our two boys.

**I don 't want to just make Ohio stand out a little more - I want it to be OUTSTANDING!**

**[So I'll ask you again: are you with me?](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.__4S9ggLZzpTKS2T3p4Mpw "So I'll ask you again: are you with me?")**

name: Marjorie Taylor Greene
subject: A warning for weak and pathetic men
body:
Jon Ossoff sided with deviant mentally ill men over our daughters

| | | | [](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a6qa/?__vbtrk=Mjc4NDkwOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc4NDkwOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
---
Friend – My daughter played fastpitch softball from the time she was a little girl until she earned her college scholarship at a Division I school. **Her journey is just one reason why _I will always stand up and fight for girls' and women's sports_**.
That’s why it disgusted me when **both Georgia Senators voted NO on legislation to block men from playing in women’s sports**.
[DEFEND OUR DAUGHTERS](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a6qa/?__vbtrk=Mjc4NDkwOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc4NDkwOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
**Jon Ossoff** and **Raphael Warnock** are spineless, weak, cowardly excuses for “men” who are completely fine letting our precious little girls get crushed – or God forbid, killed – by twisted, **mentally deranged biological males** who get their kicks spending time in girls’ locker rooms, and flattening them on the playing field.
[DEFEND OUR DAUGHTERS](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a6qa/?__vbtrk=Mjc4NDkwOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc4NDkwOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
Too many people in elected office lack the courage to stand up to this assault on our daughters.
Why do they fail to stand for what is right? **Because when you start standing up, the attacks get more, and more vicious**.
In between voting for legislation that could leave his daughter paralyzed by a mentally ill man, **Jon Ossoff has been sending emails attacking me** and**sending out mailers** asking my constituents to help him “**stop Marjorie Taylor Greene** ”.
**__Before I go on, let me make you a promise__**** _:_**_ _
**_I will never waver in the face of attacks from weak pathetic men who vote to allow girls to be beaten, and possibly even killed, by mentally ill biological men._**
These sorts of attacks happen because**I bring the raw truth directly to the American people** , Friend, and _**I am only able to do it because of the support I receive from patriots like you**_.
While other members of Congress rely on special interests to keep them running for re-election, and they agree to never step on their toes, I have no such obligations.
**Now, in light of these new attacks, __[I’m asking if you’ll chip in whatever you can to help me stand up to Jon Ossoff and the radical Democrats trying to shut me down and shut me up](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a6qa/?__vbtrk=Mjc4NDkwOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc4NDkwOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_._**
I’ll never stop fighting for you. Thank you for your continued support.
_Your fighter in Congress,_
[](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a6qa/?__vbtrk=Mjc4NDkwOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc4NDkwOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
**Marjorie Taylor Greene**
[](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a6qa/?__vbtrk=Mjc4NDkwOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc4NDkwOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
_**P.S.: These attacks on me for standing up for our innocent daughters will NEVER deter me. Jon Ossoff is a sorry excuse for a man who is more interested in defending mentally ill sexual deviants than young girls like his own daughter from injury on the court and on the field. He can attack me all he likes, but I will never back down as long as I can stay in the fight._[Will you help keep me in the fight](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a6qa/?__vbtrk=Mjc4NDkwOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc4NDkwOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_?**_

## Supreme Court Orders Aid Payments
The Supreme Court ordered the [White House to unfreeze](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL3OozAQRZ8GOiP_YlK42IYu226JzHhIJjI2sk1Q3n6VLVf6yqsrHR2dP_fl7ilSevz2O7q25UVyaRhXjI9L8BQ_i-6D2xAlqh6dsFpIc5NW9U8HEMAIM2ocpQgwrusavL0Zu8GkAkJP7kvjio9CcKv5EFaASXjD1eStmbZOcwzUchlemVJ74hY_-Y1lgLz30T1bO2qnfnVy7uR8XdeQVkh41e_fyfnIkRpB7eRcz6PgjgzyWdr_mxV8IbTKWjn3g_mwU6Laim-UU2UrBebfmQI7_IfSg53VU2CQEyuQvLhpqXhfXDguipHqaDvNH7un-M-z_dTt7eTfAAAA__--6HQF) $2 billion in payments to foreign aid organizations for work already performed. The 5-4 decision upheld [a lower court order,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z71uwyAUxfGngS3W5fLpgaGLt3TtaGHAMS02kY1C_faVu2c70pF-0v_rPt5dyml7fLo12jqXEQHlDfgN1BhcyucoaLBzjBg5jZZpwVD2qDld7MTQBGeUcU4JZNhzEBJVH5zXEqdAk7004KAYAy2gC5P3hjkJ3DgtzUwExJBq2bvvkra6xDmf5RX3zpeVZrvU-jwI_yA4EBxaa900-esjOGyxHQQHt9fkc7ymlydo9vPbNlPobsOzpZzToTQR8Fhdyv9qfVf5svgXAAD__9_iUuU) and directed the case back to the district court to clarify any additional details on payment. Justices Clarence Thomas, Samuel Alito, Neil Gorsuch and Brett Kavanaugh dissented, with [Alito writing](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0j7GOqzAQRb_GdKBhbGMoXLyGLq_dEhk8TmZlcGQ7Qfn7Fdtvd6UrnaPzdVtujiMf9_9uJ1tDWhBQtyBbGBbvOH4W1XgbiJBkQ7Y3qkc9oZHNw679pMImpwEGs2rnBq3MaNwUJHhcdWjYXjSQMPQ9GAWdX7dt7J0GOTqjxyAUkOeacved-KgPCvGT3pS7Le1NtI9an0XIfwJngfN5nt22loPOcv0C52sKnMvrmWmndkuvXNuQMvH9aB379lUce4Fzk61_nhwjl8EIBffdcfyV1L-i3xZ_AgAA__-imFmV) that a district-court judge shouldn’t have “the unchecked power to compel the government.” Administration officials are expected [to appear in court today](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGuozAQRb_GdEaDDZgULlitaFbZZostkWMPyUTGRrYTxPv6J9K_aka6OldX5_91vhryFO5_zYq6LHEWIDoOkkM_O0P-mNvK6QVRoKxQN6ptRHcRSlYPPchOGItS9bfL0vbdANKqDi4ORaNAthXpsw0k9E0DqoXa3awdGtOBHIzqhoW1gI5KTPUzUigPXPwR35hqG9fK60cpW2ZyZGJiYtr3vV5zODMmJgz8lZmYAu7n2aKnQvZ8s43llXl6ecw8Bh7QJH9wceMU-JLi1wc15PhmjhVDOSGT-Dg24xP-KCanaMkx-fvXKQb3_A_TViXttp28p9wr1sJ9NeQ_O8tP3t5afAcAAP__njdvlQ) to discuss plausible repayment schedules.
## U.S. Negotiated with Hamas Directly
The White House confirmed Wednesday that [a special U.S. envoy](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00L1y6yAQxfGngU6e5UNCKihuo863TalZm8VsAsIjiD1--4zTpz5zfsX_47ydkTPvt_9YyPdYNw16HMAMMG0BOb82K4OPRJqMJK-cVXpctDMyecALLpFmM02RLnNY7EK4kBrBRgSHkv1bAwOTUuAsnMLlep0VjmBmdOMchQUK3Otx-qy890Qxv-qDjtO1Fpl96v3ehPkn9Cr02hMlzvm9Cb2mWminZxN6xVB459YP7Fx3oddRudkuMPTju9yHjvmrDQkLtiHV1vFG75c8fLg_OWdukxMWbgX5F5f9rxAPr38CAAD__34sYLc) has engaged in unprecedented negotiations directly with Hamas and has President Trump’s authority to "talk to anyone." Sources indicate that the envoy, [led by Adam Boehler](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL1upDAUhZ_GdEb-AcwULlitqHa23C3RDb7AnRh7hD3jTJ4-In2qI50jfTr6_l-nK5CnsP6FHW1e4qSEarnQXHSTA_KvqamcXRAV6gqtNI1U7UUZXW121kJ0Rjkp215rd5FLs0gNpgMHrWpFRfakCS06KYVpRO3e5rmX0Ardg2n7hTUCHeV41LdIIW-4-Fd84lHPca-83XK-J6YHpkamxlJKvadwbkyNGPgjMTUGLGeUeHh31h-zfyR6In8kvkXvKKzc0YFz5hn8e-KF8sY32CHxGPgKn8C3mDKseHLg4MMgh5sJf5ge40yO6d-_TkFY0j887tVh3b2Q95Q6wxqx7kD--2_-yd_Tqq8AAAD__4aGcwY), recently met with Hamas officials in Doha. The U.S. has never previously engaged directly with Hamas, which has been designated a terrorist organization since 1997. Israel reportedly learned of the meeting through “other channels” but had discussed the possibility of U.S. talks with Hamas before Wednesday’s announcement. President Trump referred to the effort as [his final warning](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOszAQhJ_GdI7M2mBTuPgbuvztlWgDC-zJ2Mh2EuXtT1x_zWikkT6Nvq_7dEcOHLf_eJCva5pAQSeVlqqfFuTwmUyz-JUISDfkW2ta6Aawutm97px1A9q5cxZUa4eetDPDA80Mq9WPhv1FU1r1bausUbflMc-uxU5ph7ZzqzCKFq4p374Tx7rTGj7pRfk2p6MJfq_1LEL_EzAKGOPnTKVek4DxAgsYlb7ias8iI72LgLHm53EWGbBU-cYcOW6yJrnjgUVyyUiB5Z5KxY2KPIgqx03A2GS_nG8OgUtvhVHbgRx-n9S_zLw8_AQAAP__NQ1kUw) to Hamas, urging the group to release all remaining hostages immediately, "_OR THERE WILL BE HELL TO PAY LATER!_ "
## Storms Batter U.S. with Tornadoes, Snow
A [powerful storm system](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGO6yAQRb_G7hwNMxicguI16fLaLS3MjBNW2ESAEiVfv_L2W15d6RzpfF3nq48p7rf_fhPX1jwj4DgADWBm9jG9Z92zW0VQqBenrFY4ntFSf3fGkqAwa-RgtGJiNqtHa4AXCsH00R00IDBKgdVw4iWESfkRaPJ2nNZOg3BsuZy-c9zbXdb0zk8pp5C3Prl7a4_a0b8OLx1e_GOXVz2uY5QWQ5IOL7XlstVhSfHz8YWHuufX0HLZPedBjFHBTNrDAiNYDgJCaHkiDaTPS18cP14xpViN7TTcNh_Tr739VePp8CcAAP___AlgmQ) has swept across the United States since Monday, resulting in at least three fatalities in Mississippi. In Oklahoma, tornadoes caused significant structural damage, including the destruction of a veterinary clinic's roof in Hugo ([see video here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z7GOqzAQheGnsbugYWxjUri4DV1uuyUy43FwZHAEFij79Cu23-5IR_qk_-sxPnzKaX3-9wu7GsuIgOYG6gbdGHzKn1HL4CIzspLsWqtbNHe0Ss5OaQqaDRkbiUCZAHcVIzCCRfIEMrlLAwVd24LV0ISJqG-9AdV7a_ooNHBItWzNq6S1zhzzpxy8NVQWmd1c63sX6p_AQeBwnmczTXR9AoeVz13gcKTA5RqkYLFwvPS3KnJz4X2mnNPeWaHhufiUf836V-Ph8CcAAP__qD5SgQ)), while the Midwest faced blizzard conditions, with heavy snowfall and numerous traffic incidents reported. A massive dust storm in New Mexico led to near-zero visibility, vehicle accidents, and road closures ([video here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z71uwyAUxfGngS0WXMC4A0MXb-na0eLjEtNgiGxky336yt2zHelIP-n_fZ_uNuVUHl92QdNinYCBujFxY_0UbMrnJGkwERFQUDRcSw7qA7SgsxEWuFJeee8iOg1Oysgd17zvg5A-0GQujQnWc860ZF1w3g_cKiYGq9UQiWQYUqtr91NTaTPGfNYd187XhWYzt_baiPgkMBIYj-PonPPXR2AseGwExj0FrNfwv2s5n7nwZ6l0NeF1pJzT1msi2WOxKf-b7V3jbuAvAAD__-9RU6o)), while high winds and dry conditions have sparked wildfires in Texas, notably in San Patricio County. As the storm system advances eastward, [over 64 million people from Florida to New York](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2OwyAQhJ8Gd0TLn3EKimvc5dorLQJLzAmbCDaJ8vYnp7_m00qr-TSan8ty8bnk_fbtN3SU6iJBGg6Kw7hEn8t70UN0CVGiGtAJq4U0Z2nVsLo4JWust_qM-mrRmBREOEMYR5NSEH7I7rCBglEIsBpO8RrCJLwBNXlrpsQ0YMxU2-m35p1WTOVdn9hOoW5DcSvRvTP1xeTM5Ly_77XT8WJyPsRMzqAOHNej8x1fncm54xMb8k61bZ1T5Wsmjr4TD_XDTBk7F7Dxxx6xHTlOte0-Vv7yFFYm56G5eH_lUnIfLdNw23wun1r030xPJ_8CAAD__33vaZY) are under severe weather alerts.

| | | | | [](https://qgzxgy5ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001SPrQr6z78HnZAfj_RAFUON7tA6DMZpzfjs22f2p4s4sV7k_HFugSuyhq0ymm4PfvJFthYvqctV9g73N09UV_hHiwq-CIAD7KZLf7zdrOOsfsN7ge5RuvbExge9BRzIkItT16ll3FyspERRikHzlYYw==&c=hamN-HfLJFpbVEOmKmCBSKbJWAsZwkSMespHq3mTa0KpT6ri3wwXkA==&ch=k8-VRKXfV9IGTwmZHROGwTt9rm1vWUlftOBzkrmd03PBbM6982eDUQ==)

| Dear Peter,
Yesterday, in front of Congress, Boston Mayor Michelle Wu admitted she had NO idea how many illegal immigrants have entered Boston over the past four years or how much taxpayer money is being spent on the crisis!
Then, she let it slip that Boston does not ask about immigration status when distributing city resources.
Had enough? With your help, the MassGOP will continue fighting for the truth and exposing the horrific consequences of failed sanctuary city policies, because the time for action is long overdue.
---
| | [IT'S TIME FOR ACTION - CHIP IN NOW](https://qgzxgy5ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001SPrQr6z78HnZAfj_RAFUON7tA6DMZpzfjs22f2p4s4sV7k_HFugSu1qVUh5r473dWRLTKkNMtU_g6T6kI88KRpySeFrhdZwJIhbEgRq9F4ZHBDaGiEkuNE4iwERFdXbvPpHM5DK047ZDb-1W1YD6TjcmSZ6TrEyXoN454aoN_xIX8ShSmSj7bA==&c=hamN-HfLJFpbVEOmKmCBSKbJWAsZwkSMespHq3mTa0KpT6ri3wwXkA==&ch=k8-VRKXfV9IGTwmZHROGwTt9rm1vWUlftOBzkrmd03PBbM6982eDUQ==)

The MassGOP recently backed a bombshell FOIA request that revealed over 1,000 serious incidents in taxpayer-funded emergency migrant shelters since 2022.
And every day we uncover more horrific realities, like the case of Wiseteguens Jean Quely Charles, a Haitian illegal immigrant and known member of a violent street gang, who racked up 17 criminal convictions, including multiple drug, weapons, and assault offenses. Protected by sanctuary policies, Charles remained in Boston, shielded from deportation by Mayor Wu --until ICE agents stepped in to remove him from the streets.
Adding to the outrage, the City of Boston spent $650,000 of taxpayer money preparing Mayor Wu to defend her own policies.
So, have you had enough?
Signal to the Democratic Supermajority that you want action on the migrant crisis NOW.
Stand with Republicans as we fight for the truth and for commonsense solutions.
---

Thank you,

Amy Carnevale

Renowned cardiothoracic surgeon Dr. Steven Gundry has found an invisible problem affecting almost everything we eat. But almost nobody knows it's happening except the big food companies responsible for it.

And Dr. Gundry's research shows it could be the true cause of low energy, digestive issues, and unwanted weight gain in millions of Americans over 35.

But that's not even the worst part.

Because this problem has flown under the radar for decades, there are no rules to protect us. Nobody is stopping these companies from doing this to our food, says Dr. Gundry.

He exposes exactly what's happening and what you can do about it in a **[new whistleblowing video report that reveals his shocking research.](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8zs1uozAQwPGnMbegmfEH4eBDdrNEq93mUKlqcjS2KW5xIUBi8fYVUZTrzE_zHxOHLjSLZsUvRtQGNzEixneM6HJOcbx-xn-HzfsSi81FHaNct_T7QW_0xN_W8D-nv7tDfOsndNi685Bu-OTzMvgnfkRzH03o1mmxz5zmjQOReY2FQFKAErNWk3dQWmkbS9hIK_wWAEQparDbUtptFjQBSeCgEIlQ5AbAK1MLpaQQjXNMwL2Tm-jHYA1OczLj2Pcxt33MOt3O8zDdH6sYVSmlvG6j68yXX1bBqKqOJ_GKjCr-og7_sVwlr6ZrjYzvFaLIRu2GFLouTKpgAj7uwfX8TdNPAAAA__9kEWfN)**

**Once you've seen this, Dr. Gundry says, you'll never buy groceries the same way again.**

It's a technique he's been using himself and at age 74, he says it's the reason he looks and feels decades younger.

The video has quickly gone viral, with thousands of people saying they've been using Dr. Gundry's simple discovery at breakfast every day.

And as a result, they report having more energy, improved digestion, more comfortable joints, and a slimmer waistline.

Dr. Gundry has granted permission for us to share the full video below, completely free.

**Good morning!** On this day in 1836, [the Alamo fell](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z7GOrCAUgOGngU4DB0SmoLiN3dx2S3MYjkoCMkFWZ95-M9tv_-dL_q_7fMeY4r7-x0yuvZYyg4ChE6oTZg4Y03vWPDgvwk1ycnLUEgxoY_nmwEtFpOzDBr2gVcr7xYBWNODNjvrBo_tgQgkj5TCC7INRVtqbHQdrvaCBaUEhtlL7tlGjFx5LepeTav8omSe3tfY8mPrHYGIwXdf16TBhLn2pK4OpUqbsqTKYPLaWqMM9dJXOkr5bLDuvLjyvmFI8zMi0WDPG9Iu3P29PBz8BAAD__3DSV7o) to Mexican forces led by General Santa Anna following a 13-day siege. The death of the nearly 200 defenders inspired many Texans to join the fight for independence. Today, Houston's Intuitive Machines will attempt to put its Nova-C lander on the moon at 11:32 a.m. CT. ## U.S. Rep. Sylvester Turner Dies
U.S. Rep. Sylvester Turner (D-Houston) [passed away yesterday morning](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGvpSAUhH-NdscAInILChu7t-2W5lw5PtkgGEB9_vuNt3_VfMkkM5P5-zV9ofMufP_BjUz5WeIkmOiAtcDUZNH5e5K1NW9mX7wmw3vJhRJS6Xo1vRadZIoWhpK_lWYde82cOqa1nLGfa2eeMNYyxXnXC95Y1WquX7rvtH4z6irJyLoSU1NWKvSDefF3PCk1c9xqb9ZS9ly1QyXGSozXdTVbDo9XiZECHLkSY6DrkQ97dxIcu8VCGZaYNkqwxiOXGGDDOybItz8pF0pQjhQogXVkAQtYmAF3TGWjUCAugPuO6eGA5UjoYcYj09OCCYaBD_88ujoZu1_Oe5dVX0n2vaHzn_Hl1zdPI_4HAAD__5lteXo) at his home in Washington, D.C. The 70-year-old’s family described his death as “unexpected.” Turner had attended President Trump’s address at the Capitol the night before. Turner represented Houston in the Texas House for 27 years before he was [elected mayor in 2016](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL3O4yAQAJ8Gd1js8mNcUFxDl2uvtLBZYnQkRJjEydufcv1XjzQazZ_Lcgm55Pv1d7iR6-9UFxSouZBcmCWGXD6LGqJbRZxhIAeTAjSojB12Z1KEADMIK7eJ4hTDGlTSCmPQUuppyO4rE1IYAD0hjNFIC3a2k7Z2FaSZEhRzr23sO3V6hyOVT31RG7d6G4rbe38cTP5i6Bn68zzHv3t9fiFDH1rPWyGG_k7nwdCXuoXC0B-f8qKjU-P92e7UeF1zZ-jRag6UpElS8xln4CoR8hmS4rDFNYQZt5VoaC4-zlxKPszElLjeQi7_i_qPi14O_wUAAP__eoJmUA). During his two terms, he orchestrated the city’s response to Hurricane Harvey and the COVID-19 pandemic and led initiatives to reduce the city’s debt and implement police reforms. Turner, who was treated for bone cancer in 2022, [succeeded Rep. Sheila Jackson Lee](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2O4yAURp8GdzeCi_lxQbGNu2y7pYXNdcwONhGQTPz2o6Sf-pO-c3T-Xaerjyket79-J9dea56QowIugesp-JjOqe-Cm3kYREdOmF6gxl7bbnMKZ8NnVAKNHGYVlNRI_boYK-QsDXXRvc-45FoIZVBcgpZW2MEaZe3MSbGeU4gtl0vbqNHL1zWd-UnlsuS9S25r7V6Z_MNwZDj6eRHyvTAc77k2hmM905NqowLtUQ4qsOayU4Hdn7nAlh-15QPWmBIFqBvF5OG_X75qPiARVajkG4RYW4lLA2Fh8xVCpAAfGiTy5aDAcBRqsFxIzXDsigv375hSrNqwnt92H9NHuf3a8OnwJwAA__9jhHOp) in the U.S. House after she passed away last July. Before his career in politics, he worked in corporate law, having obtained degrees from Harvard Law School and the University of Houston. Mayor John Whitmire [announced his longtime friend’s death](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j72OhCAYAJ8GOwx88ltQXGO3115pcPlcSVA2wK769pe9_upJZjI_t-nmY4r749tv6Nq55AkYSMoGytQUfEzXJLrgZhYs79BxLTgoEMp0q7ujlt5q9PMgICiDzHolFiWG2c_ybrvoPjI2MMW51MD7oAbDjTVaGjMzlEQwDLHl0rcVG56-LunKbyz9PW9dcmtrz0qGLwIjgfE4jn7JJ9gPJTDueFQCY8EnrVd6Y21YaHuVHQtdctmw0DW_ass73fyVCw0Ra1dceB4xpViVJoI9Nh_TX679-_928BsAAP__KBterA) during a city council meeting. Exciting news... Today we are officially launching the **[Mountain Minute Podcast](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._w/sfj9e5e1367)**! In just three minutes, we cut through the noise to bring you the latest headlines—unfiltered, uncensored, and straight to the point. Whether you’re commuting, grabbing coffee, or just short on time, we’ve got you covered.
Here is a summary of today's top stories: ****
**🏛️ Colorado Legislative Session Updates...** Lawmakers oppose closing [Delta and Rifle Correctional Facilities](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._w/sak56b9a5eb), warning it would hurt local economies, cut rehabilitation programs, and worsen workforce shortages amid Colorado’s $1.2 billion budget shortfall.

**🏔️ Here in Colorado...** Colorado Secretary of State Jena Griswold faces a campaign finance probe, accused of [politicizing her office](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._w/sdjb310ba54). Grand County ranchers receive $350,000 for [wolf-related livestock losses](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._w/sdta9161190) amid ongoing policy disputes. The DOJ is investigating whether Tina Peters is a [political prisoner](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._w/scg4ddeb580), with supporters citing her election security claims.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Republicans call for prosecuting [sanctuary city mayors](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._w/s7p82e71aa0) over immigration law violations. Trump announced the capture of the terrorist behind the 2021 [Abbey Gate bombing](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._w/samc0f21473). A Texas congressman proposes putting Trump on the [$100 bill](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._w/s7nc688e6c4), sparking debate. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy called Trump’s stance on cutting U.S. aid to Ukraine []()[]()[“regrettable,”](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._w/sdg6f2db256) as debates over foreign assistance escalate.

This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, March 6, 2025.
– Heidi Ganahl

**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Sanctuary mayors broke laws, engaged in ‘an act of treason’ and should be prosecuted, some Republicans say](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._w/s1mad4c57ad)** BY BRIAN PORTER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._w/s1u9dc4d7c2)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._w/scqb4dc8e3c)
At least one member of Congress is referring criminal prosecution of Denver Mayor Mike Johnston to U.S. Attorney General Pam Bondi, on grounds he violated his oath and U.S. law, and another alleges him to be a traitor to the country.
Those were but two of the allegations the mayor faced during a marathon hearing Wednesday on Capitol Hill in the U.S. House Oversight and Government Reform Committee pertaining to sanctuary cities. He was joined on a panel by the mayors of Boston, Chicago and New York City.
“I’ve heard you say Denver’s crime went down, well Aurora’s crime went up,” said U.S. Rep. Lauren Boebert, R-Windsor, Colo., who visited the city this summer most known nationally for Tren de Aragua gang activity.

**[In Department of Justice inquiry to Tina Peters’ case, the question is whether she is a political prisoner](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._w/s9v262eb3c2)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._w/s4k04081639)
* The U.S. Department of Justice is examining whether former Mesa County Clerk Tina Peters was unfairly prosecuted, questioning if her nine-year sentence was politically motivated and disproportionately harsh for a nonviolent offense.
* The DOJ inquiry is part of a broader effort to investigate whether law enforcement has been weaponized for political purposes. Peters' defense argues her prosecution was meant to silence election integrity concerns, while similar cases elsewhere resulted in no legal consequences.
* If the federal review supports Peters’ claims, it could set a precedent for how election-related cases are handled in the future, particularly regarding the balance between state and federal oversight of election data.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._w/sfr84488b41)**
|
---
**[JBC weighing the closure of correctional facilities in Western Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._w/s1m4b84842f)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._w/s7r9061e4f8)
* Lawmakers from both parties, including Reps. Matt Soper and Elizabeth Velasco, are pushing back against the Joint Budget Committee’s proposal to close the Delta and Rifle Correctional Facilities due to budget shortfalls, arguing the decision was made without legislative input.
* The closures would eliminate 140 jobs in Delta County alone, significantly affecting local economies. Additionally, the Rifle facility houses rehabilitation programs that help inmates develop job skills, reducing recidivism.
* Critics highlight alternative areas for budget cuts, pointing to state spending on Medicaid fraud, environmental justice programs, and financial support for illegal immigrants as better targets for reducing costs.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._w/s1p19df3e07)**
|
---
**[Trump on the $100 bill? A measure by a Texas congressman proposes it, in a removal of a Founding Father](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._w/s6ofad74e43)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice._w/sdof9197bd4)
* U.S. Rep. Brandon Gill introduced the "Golden Age Act of 2025," which seeks to replace Benjamin Franklin with Donald Trump on all newly printed $100 bills starting in 2028.
* Gill argues that Trump’s leadership in securing the border, reshaping trade policies, and pursuing energy independence makes him the defining figure of America's "golden age," warranting his placement on the nation’s most widely circulated currency.
* The measure has sparked controversy, as Franklin was a key figure in American history, known for his diplomatic efforts, scientific discoveries, and foundational contributions to the U.S. monetary system.

name: Lesley Davis
subject: Update: Bills to stop DEI remain alive
body:
Get the latest updates and learn how to take action. | | | |
---
| | | Dear friends, While many of us were tuned into President Trump’s remarkable, inspiring speech Tuesday night, Tuesday was also another big day in the Mississippi legislative process. All bills that had passed one chamber now needed to clear committee to remain alive. Some did. Some didn’t. We’ll dive into that below.
---
|
### **Bills to stop DEI remain alive**
---
| Legislation that will protect students from divisive DEI teachings continues to advance in both chambers. We have seen direct and immediate directives from the Trump administration wiping out DEI at the federal level. We now need strong accountability via private cause of action or AG enforcement on the state level. There is no way we can trust the federal or state education establishment to rid us of this rot. Both bills that would restrict DEI are still alive. [House Bill 1193](https://gmail.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=38e7573a4604819e3af8c7b86&id=6005942c32&e=6f9b7d8fd0), sponsored by Rep. Joey Hood, and [Senate Bill 2515](https://gmail.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=38e7573a4604819e3af8c7b86&id=218e1bcaad&e=6f9b7d8fd0), sponsored by Sen. Nicole Boyd, advanced out of committee and are headed to the Senate and House floors, respectively. Changes were made to both bills so lawmakers will have to hash out differences before a bill can make it to the Governor. Let’s come together and fix this woke madness now.
---
|
### **Protecting women**
---
| Legislation to protect the safety, privacy, and dignity of women in correctional facilities advanced. [House Bill 188](https://gmail.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=38e7573a4604819e3af8c7b86&id=bd406195c6&e=6f9b7d8fd0), sponsored by Rep. Gene Newman, known as the Dignity and Safety for Incarcerated Women Act, cleared the Senate Corrections Committee after passing the House. It would mandate that restrooms, changing rooms, and sleeping quarters in correctional facilities be designated exclusively for males or females and that incarcerated individuals can only access facilities designated for their biological sex.
---
|
### **Parental rights bill dies in the Senate**
---
| All bills to reinforce parental authority and limit government overreach into family decisions did not make it out of the Senate Education Committee. [House Bill 1081](https://gmail.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=38e7573a4604819e3af8c7b86&id=88e7b6e7d3&e=6f9b7d8fd0), sponsored by Rep. Kimberly Remak, would affirm and protect parents' fundamental rights to direct the upbringing, education, care, and custody of their children. It passed the House with just 5 dissenting votes. This comes two weeks after that same committee refused to consider [Senate Bill 2897](https://gmail.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=38e7573a4604819e3af8c7b86&id=054945218a&e=6f9b7d8fd0), Sen. Tyler McCaughn’s strong parental rights legislation. Similarly, the House killed [House Bill 120](https://gmail.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=38e7573a4604819e3af8c7b86&id=633340cf10&e=6f9b7d8fd0), sponsored by Rep. Lee Yancey, which would prohibit health care providers and institutions from providing health care to children without parental consent earlier in the session. Why is this so hard to pass by our lawmakers when the electorate is so strongly in favor?
---
|
### **What else happened?**
---
| 👉 [House Bill 599](https://gmail.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=38e7573a4604819e3af8c7b86&id=07c40017d3&e=6f9b7d8fd0), sponsored by Rep. Price Wallace, would add civil liabilities for child sexual exploitation, distribution of child pornography and other obscene matters by commercial entities. It cleared the Senate Judiciary A committee and now heads to the Senate floor. 👉 [House Bill 1308](https://gmail.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=38e7573a4604819e3af8c7b86&id=6405aa5f5d&e=6f9b7d8fd0), sponsored by Rep. Jansen Owen would create a crime for the sexual grooming of children. It cleared the Senate Judiciary B committee and now heads to the Senate floor. A companion bill, [Senate Bill 2309](https://gmail.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=38e7573a4604819e3af8c7b86&id=343a8e8d65&e=6f9b7d8fd0), sponsored by Sen. Joey Fillingane, did not advance in the House. 👉 [Senate Bill 2192](https://gmail.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=38e7573a4604819e3af8c7b86&id=3ef2a0c474&e=6f9b7d8fd0), sponsored by Sen. Angela Hill, which would require the identification of sex on a driver’s license to be consistent with the sex of the individual that was determined at birth did not advance out of committee in the House and it is dead. Let’s keep working to get these strong bills over the finish line! Stay tuned!
---
|

Hi. I bet that's not what you were expecting on a big red hat these days

_(But don 't you worry, I'm about as pro-Trump as they come!)_

_My name 's Marlin Stutzman._ I'm a 4th-generation farmer raising the finest Wagyu cows this side of the Mississippi. When I'm not herding cattle and hauling hay, I'm fighting the good fight in the People's House.

I ran for office because the Democrats AND even some Republicans have stabbed farmers like me in the back for as long as I can remember.

Ask any farmer - they'll show you the scars.

**I swear elites in DC think meat and produce *magically appear* at Whole Foods - not because farmers devote their blood, sweat, and tears to their trade. **

That's how they can sleep at night knowing...
* China is buying up our farmland
* Democrats taxed us into oblivion
* Liberals want to replace beef with fake meat made from God knows what
* Politicians get rich at our expense
* We're left to pick up the scraps

My entire life is focused on bringing all that to a screeching halt. And the political class knows I can't be bought off or bribed. That's why they're mobilizing the powers-at-be to silence me so they can keep the gravy train rolling.

_And holding the line here will be tougher than a $3 steak._

**[That's why I'm left with no choice but to ask you for a small donation today to keep me in Congress. I don't care if it's $3 or $300 - the amount doesn't matter nearly as much as the number of people who give.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z4e6pghaqrk8egtlqn7da02phrhef4hov84gjd4o_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c9ge2o30cdh2bs "That’s why I’m left with no choice but to ask you for a small donation today to keep me in Congress. **WYOMING** The 2025 legislative session is coming to a close, and the **Wyoming Freedom Caucus** has secured several amazing victories. Here are some bills that recently passed and became law:
---
* Universal school choice (HB 199)
* Homeschool Freedom Act (HB 46)
* Broad-based property tax cut (SF69)
* Banned DEI for all government agencies (HB 147)
* Banned drivers licenses for illegal aliens (HB 116)
* Banned Central Bank Digital Currencies (HB 264)
* Repeal of "Gun Free Zones" (HB 172)
* Protect Women's Spaces (HB 72)

---
**Passing most, if not all of the above bills, was unthinkable two years ago.** On school choice in particular, the former Wyoming House speaker unilaterally killed it in 2023. And while the legislature passed school choice in 2024, liberal "Republican" Governor Gordon line-item vetoed almost all of it. But because of the Wyoming Freedom Caucus's unwavering commitment to conservative reforms, they kept pushing and got it across the finish line this year.That's great news and a testament to the Wyoming Freedom Caucus's principled leadership, but not everything got signed into law because the State Senate killed some great bills. They include:
---
* A bill that would require primary runoff elections (HB 249)
* A ban on ballot drop boxes (HB 131)
* Prohibition of tax dollars to fund drag shows (HB 134)
* More hospital price transparency (HB 121)
* A ban on foreign ownership of property (HJ 2)
* Repeal of state carbon capture mandates (HB 209)

---
But like school choice, the **Wyoming Freedom Caucus** will keep pushing these bills and other conservative priorities in the months and years to come to make them a reality.
---
|
---
**SOUTH DAKOTA** One of the **South Dakota Freedom Caucus** 's top priorities this year was to pass a bill that would protect landowners from eminent domain abuse. It's a long story, but they have been fighting this issue for almost two years because a green energy company was using the force of government to take private property from landowners so they could build a CO2 pipeline. It was such a hot issue that 14 liberal Republicans who supported the pipeline lost their primary elections last fall. Despite some setbacks, the legislature finally got the message and passed HB 1052 that would ban eminent domain abuse. We believe the liberal Governor Larry Rhoden (who recently replaced Kristi Noem) could veto the bill. The State House has the votes to override the veto, but the State Senate is a close call. We'll update you once we learn more.
---
|
---

The Democrats realized that, while they may love the bill, they knew their voters were adamantly opposed to it.

Friend,

**This is a deeply personal email, but I want to tell you why it’s critical for us to take back our culture and education from the radical left... not just in sports, but even in children’s books. **

My story begins at the University of Kentucky. I was on the swim team. I am a 12-time NCAA all-American, 5x SEC champion, and SEC record holder in the butterfly.

But then it all changed for a photo-op.

In March of 2022, I and other female swimmers were forced to compete with a male, Lia Thomas. We watched as this male swam to a title, beating out Olympians and other record holders. Despite tying Lia to the 100th of a second, the NCAA denied me the trophy because the NCAA claimed it was necessary to have Lia Thomas hold the trophy while photos were being taken.

The radical left reduced everything I worked my entire life for down to a photo op.

But that’s not all...

I was forced to share locker rooms with a 6’4” man.

**_This is where the madness needs to end because it’s not just sports where the radical gender ideology movement is dominating_.**

Now, children’s literature is injected with this radical gender ideology movement.

body:
It isn’t rocket-science. It’s basic math.

| |
