| |
---
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z68gq3ak33o5vhre75cmoa6sc3st0qhivhkj9iqg_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c9ge9ob2c5h2bs)
---
| | **“****A disproportionate number of illegal immigrants go to blue states, they amplify the effect of a blue state vote. My understanding is that Democrats would lose approximately 20 seats in the house if illegals were not counted in census. And that’s also 20 less electoral votes for president.**** ** **So, illegals absolutely do impact who controls the House and the presidency.”****~** Elon Musk
---
| | Fellow Conservative,Elon Musk is right. It isn’t rocket-science. It’s basic math. It’s also a ticking time-bomb set by Joe Biden and Kamala Harris – in the form of 11.5 million illegals entering our country on their watch – one which will explode shortly after President Trump leaves office in 2029.While you and I have no doubt President Trump will deliver on his promise to secure the border, this threat will not go away. The truth is, without immediate action, these illegal aliens will be counted in the U.S. Census, which determines both the apportionment of seats in the House of Representatives _and_ the number of electoral votes given to each state. Whether they came because, four years ago, Kamala Harris and Joe Biden prompted them to “surge to the border” for asylum or because of blue-states offering sanctuary status, “free” health care, “free” cell phones, “free” housing, and “free” college...it doesn’t matter. The result is the same.Your vote is _already_ being **watered down** in Congress. Your vote is _already_ being **watered down** in the Electoral College.And every day reports are popping up of non-citizens, illegal aliens, and convicted felons being registered to vote in cities and entire swing-states across the country, which means your vote may be fully **canceled out in future elections**. **_American elections should be decided by American citizens._****[If you agree then please sign your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution so the chaos we’re seeing now _never_ happens again in America.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z2lcplbqt4e71jp1fervff0dvdeg1ujjg3arc6t0_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c9ge9ob2c5h2bs)**Because, here’s the scary part:The last census took place in 2020. That was _before_ the 11.5 million illegal aliens who invaded our country under Joe Biden and Kamala Harris. To put it in context, there are only 8 states in America with a population over 11 million. So, it’s as if the radical Left just imported the 9th largest state in America. That’s more than North Carolina (10.8 million), Michigan (10 million), New Jersey (9.2 million), or Virginia (8.7 million).You get the picture. That’s why urgent action is needed to pass a Constitutional Amendment to ban illegal aliens from voting and from being counted for purposes of congressional and electoral vote apportionment. The next census in less than 6 years away. If those 11.5 million illegal aliens are counted in the census or are allowed to vote in the intervening years, you and I simply won’t have a country. **[It’s vitally important that your representatives in Washington and in your state legislature hear this demand directly from you.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zohf78h7094075cj70bq64emeudb4g537sijo350_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c9ge9ob2c5h2bs)** Because, quite honestly, they think they can pull a fast one on you. They think you and I will be so relieved to see the border secure again and criminal illegal aliens deported, that you and I will be oblivious to this threat lying dormant under our very eyes.No way.My name is Rebecca Weber. I’m the chairwoman of AMAC Action. **AMAC Action is the most influential advocacy group in the country when it comes to standing for the values of conservative Seniors.****We’ve got 72 chapters and 300 volunteer delegates, who are the “feet on the street” advocates who contact Members of Congress and state legislators in their district offices.** **Moreover, our chapters and delegates help organize Town Hall meetings with elected officials and candidates to enable those locally of our 2,000,000 AMAC members to meet, hear, and question them.****And you should also know that we now have more than 337,000 AMAC members who respond to our “calls-to-action” and weigh in with members of the** **U.S. House and Senate, as well as their state legislators on the issues.** Quite simply, when we speak, Washington listens. [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zre4ej7mqg8i0rv5a5k3kd1ue349rr0cp0q2oef0_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c9ge9ob2c5h2bs)**[And AMAC Action needs your help today in this do-or-die battle to pass a Constitutional Amendment to protect your vote from being canceled out by an illegal alien or a convicted felon.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z0qb9enkhsdl2f97e2ai1s4rj8b9bri3ee4avr40_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c9ge9ob2c5h2bs)** But I can’t do it without you. **No matter what issue you care about the most, if you and I don’t have a secure,_honest_ elections... none of it matters.**Inflation. Illegal immigration. Violent Crime. Drug use. Homelessness. The 2nd Amendment. Out of control spending. Social Security and Medicare insolvency. Right to Life. Indoctrination in our schools. Endless foreign wars. You name it. **[So please follow this link to sign your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z8cks5c0iktr74efg9u2vc1vgte0h5b0eb2u3hng_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c9ge9ob2c5h2bs)** so that AMAC Action can put your representatives in Washington and in the state legislature on notice with a simple demand: Namely, that you will not tolerate this erosion of your vote.Now, here’s the bad news:Most state constitutions grant voting rights to “every” citizen, open-ended language that liberal activists argue permits localities to authorize non-citizen and even illegal alien voting. States should amend their constitutions to instead permit “only” citizens to vote. But there’s good news, too:Seven states have _expressly_ banned non-citizen voting already: Alabama, Arizona, Colorado, Florida, Louisiana, North Dakota, and Ohio.**What’s more, voters approve of constitutional amendments to ban non-citizen voting by overwhelming margins. Nearly 77% of Ohio voters approved a measure in 2022, while nearly 63% of Colorado voters approved one in 2020.** This is a solution whose time has come. You and I can do this. **[That’s why, when you’ve signed your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zlo95th6ua00chm2i1cmooiinemnue5kb8dftar8_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c9ge9ob2c5h2bs), I'm also asking you to make a one-time contribution of $35 to give AMAC Action the resources to send out, collect, process, and tabulate millions of petitions.** The reality is, we don’t get a dime of taxpayer funding. Our funding comes from grassroots conservatives like you who care deeply about the future of America. This is important. _It means we can’t be bought._ On the other hand, the leftwing election fraud machine is funded by leftwing billionaires like Mark Zuckerberg and George Soros who are actively funneling _billions_ to dark money “non-profit” groups to “**reshape** ” our elections and our electorate.With that said, if you’re able to make a larger contribution – say $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, or even $1,000 – it would really be a life saver. Please hurry. In order to secure your vote in all future elections – and with 11.5 million illegals chomping to be included in the next census – **[your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution is vitally important.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zi4io6ganrmje9e60iq2vna31lr9kkb2bmmdffng_rp22sh2s8i6eob4c9ge9ob2c5h2bs)** Yes, this is about saving your vote from being canceled. It’s also about saving America.And it all starts with the straightforward premise that non-citizens and illegal aliens – no matter how many Kamala Harris and Joe Biden imported on their watch – should be banned from voting _and_ banned from being counted for apportioning congressional seats and electoral votes. Thank you in advance for joining the fight to secure your vote

But there’s good news, too:Seven states have expressly banned non-citizen voting already: Alabama, Arizona, Colorado, Florida, Louisiana, North Dakota, and Ohio.What’s more, voters approve of constitutional amendments to ban non-citizen voting by overwhelming margins. **["It is a mandate and I'm going to explain why,"](https://substack.com/redirect/fff10a91-0e0a-4648-8ed2-e023f576b6d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Smith began. "I'm no supporter of Trump but I am a supporter of the truth and facts!"

Smith added insult to injury, telling Behar and Whoopi that the election also served as an total indictment of what the Democrat Party was offering American citizens.

Hi everyone. Senator Elissa Slotkin here.

Last night I gave the official response to President Trump’s Joint Address. I hope you had a chance to watch.

Since I’m a stranger to most people who don’t follow politics, I introduced myself and just kept it straight with the people watching about the moment we are in right now.

We just went through another fraught election season. Americans made it clear that they want change. But there is a responsible way to make change, and a reckless way. And, we can make that change without forgetting who we are as a country, and as a democracy.

Because no matter where you live, most Americans share three core beliefs: That the middle class is the engine of our country. That strong national security protects us from harm. And that our democracy, no matter how messy, is unparalleled and worth fighting for.

We all know that our country is going through something right now. We’re not sure what the next day is going to hold, let alone the next decade.

But this isn’t the first time we’ve experienced this as a country. Every single time, we’ve gotten through those moments because of two things: Engaged citizens and principled leaders.

If you're with me in that fight, I have an ask of you:

name: Jim Schultz
subject: Put Working Families First: Time to Cut Taxes to Protect Minnesota’s Future
body:
Higher taxes will exacerbate the reality that a significant number of Minnesotans are heading to other states. We need to make it easier to live here.

| | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us18.campaign-archive.com/?e=baf210d431&u=e307c9beec837f7456d65a5e6&id=b1bc793763)
---
| | | | [](https://growthmn.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e307c9beec837f7456d65a5e6&id=fbe82a5acd&e=baf210d431)
---
| Dear Friend,
Just two years ago, Minnesota had a historic surplus of nearly $19 billion. Yet instead of using that windfall to deliver lasting relief to the taxpayers who helped create it, DFL legislators pushed through a massive spending spree and introduced a host of new taxes. Today, our state faces a projected [**budget deficit**](https://growthmn.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e307c9beec837f7456d65a5e6&id=370c482d02&e=baf210d431) of $5.1 billion, and working families are caught in the middle. If we fail to act, that deficit will be “fixed” by even more tax hikes, compounding the burden on Minnesotans who already pay some of the highest tax rates in the country. It’s time for our elected officials to put working families first by cutting taxes and rolling back the punitive increases that helped create this mess.
**Minnesotans Want Lower Taxes** Recent polling confirms what we already know: Minnesotans overwhelmingly want lower taxes. According to a [_**KSTP/SurveyUSA**_**poll**](https://growthmn.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e307c9beec837f7456d65a5e6&id=88b3cf9808&e=baf210d431) , 25% of respondents named “lowering taxes” as the single most pressing issue for legislators—more than any other topic. Voters see right through the notion that Minnesota simply has a revenue problem. In reality, the issue is spending, fueled by a liberal willingness to use the record-high surplus to expand government programs rather than provide genuine tax relief.
**A Dire Competitive Climate** Not surprisingly, Minnesota ranks **44th overall** on the [**2025 State Tax Competitiveness Index**](https://growthmn.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e307c9beec837f7456d65a5e6&id=b65d8d5615&e=baf210d431) , weighed down by our highly progressive income taxes, hefty sales taxes, and the nation’s second-highest corporate tax rate at 9.8%. These burdens disincentivize entrepreneurs from setting up shop in Minnesota, undercutting job creation and wage growth.
Unsurprisingly, a separate [**study**](https://growthmn.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e307c9beec837f7456d65a5e6&id=0fbdbfbc3b&e=baf210d431) placed Minnesota **49th out of 50 states for entrepreneurs** , citing a drop in new business applications and high inflation as contributing factors. None of this should come as a surprise. When taxes rise, employers look elsewhere to invest, slowing our economic engine and making it harder for families to make ends meet.
**Tax Relief That Helps Everyone** Rather than doubling down on failed tax-and-spend policies, we must unlock Minnesota’s potential by offering substantial tax relief. Here are four immediate steps to spark our economic renewal:
1. **Eliminate the First Income Tax Bracket**

Allowing the first $50,000 of income for married filers to be tax-free (currently taxed at 5.35%) would provide working families with annual savings of up to $2,500. Over time, that’s real money back in the pockets of everyday Minnesotans who need it most.
2. **Lower the Corporate Tax Rate**

Reducing the corporate rate from 9.8% to 8.0% would move Minnesota out of the top tier of states with the highest business taxes. The result? More job openings, better wages, and a stronger economy powered by local entrepreneurship and investment.
3. **Return Future Surpluses to Taxpayers**

House Republicans have introduced a plan for a constitutional amendment that would automatically return a portion of future budget surpluses to taxpayers, preventing lawmakers from repeating the mistakes made during the $19 billion surplus bonanza.
4. **Fully Eliminate the Tax on Social Security Benefits**

It’s high time we ended Minnesota’s tax on Social Security benefits, allowing seniors to keep more of their hard-earned income and enjoy a secure retirement. Many liberal politicians promised this during campaign season—it’s time to deliver.
**A Call to Action** This is more than just a policy debate; it’s about the future of our state and the ability of everyday Minnesotans to make ends meet. Higher taxes will only exacerbate the reality that a significant number of Minnesotans are heading to other states. We need to make it easier to live, work, and raise a family in Minnesota, and one good place to start is by lowering taxes for all.

Working with you,
**Jim Schultz** PresidentMinnesota Private Business Council
**P.S.** If you believe in protecting our freedoms and safeguarding the rule of law, consider joining the fight by becoming a [**Main Street Member of the Minnesota Private Business Council**](https://growthmn.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e307c9beec837f7456d65a5e6&id=d43ec6f040&e=baf210d431). Together, we can ensure that our constitutional rights endure for future generations. Membership offers numerous benefits, including:
* **Bimonthly newsletter:** Stay informed with key policy and business updates.
* **Real-time alerts:** Get timely information on critical state legislation.
* **Exclusive insights:** Access to key polling and political landscape analyses.
* **Advocacy:** Join us in advocating for the policies that will renew Minnesota’s promise.

**Cost:** $100 per year—a small investment for a significant impact.
Join us in this crucial fight for the future of Minnesota. Together, we can ensure that our state not only recovers, but thrives. Your support is vital in this mission.
[**Become a Main Street Member today**](https://growthmn.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e307c9beec837f7456d65a5e6&id=09b270653b&e=baf210d431).

Why chemistry?

_**A message from our sponsor...**_

| | | [](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=3c50588c192044d4a00f97e5264d631f&_e=bUH19UfyT1ZObTuKxHtml93fUkcTn-yGY8csL9Ud9jKyCfTh_8jC63vHSuvK2T28dhr_T-XOVoP69XlIEeWP6o258RopwoZVeoEZczgTaem187bTNAkLwG0o34rqT1cqP5F6gTlvBiV8gkONIbT2h_PItAGlgBciumkb5MO5bNHA6Fwc0VcnAPTdPKWb4TZurgzblWKWFFpZLuFHdhFO1gLtm60RSsfg9jYERNAUqklOFm110Ci6By0Yr8UC9kL3Rmd0czVfUnuIoO4ZvE7pj8YmSKomRbmaNgNqmO2bsLSsaolArtK0hgr9XjiuiMl1Z-eGP4YdF_JfLIVsSfqz50a3tP24ukdYw0ZHZWacEXcTo6iX3e8CcMh3JYqrAsKYe-8zuu4VmvQdaIaQbzziFPTzIzVY1oZ8UpXKy5KDrss%3D)

| | Dear Friend,

There's a tough question that I have to ask you on this fine day.

Here it is...What is true about the world?

Tough, right?

It's a question mankind has asked since ancient times--since creation itself. So, if you don't know the answer, that's fine (if you do, email me because I would love to know more!).

This question is especially pressing today because of the growing power modern humans have to change and manipulate the material world.

That's one of the reasons we released our free online course, **" The Great Principles of Chemistry."**

Why chemistry?

For one, this course brings a core subject studied at Hillsdale College to millions of Americans, including you.

More fundamentally, we study chemistry as part of our liberal arts education at Hillsdale because the sciences help us understand important aspects of reality. It helps us think about our role as humans in the world around us and reveals the framework, implications, and potential for human life.

Like all our courses, **" The Great Principles of Chemistry"** contains stunning visuals, study guides, quizzes, and in this case, hands-on experiments. This content is especially well-suited for science teachers, homeschool parents, or lifelong learners.

And our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

**For any donation of $100 or more, you will receive a beautiful DVD box set for "The Great Principles of Chemistry," by clicking the link below:

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/principles-of-chemistry](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=3c50588c192044d4a00f97e5264d631f&_e=bUH19UfyT1ZObTuKxHtml93fUkcTn-yGY8csL9Ud9jKyCfTh_8jC63vHSuvK2T28dhr_T-XOVoP69XlIEeWP6o258RopwoZVeoEZczgTaem187bTNAkLwG0o34rqT1cqP5F6gTlvBiV8gkONIbT2h_PItAGlgBciumkb5MO5bNHA6Fwc0VcnAPTdPKWb4TZurgzblWKWFFpZLuFHdhFO1gLtm60RSsfg9jYERNAUqklOFm110Ci6By0Yr8UC9kL3q-9-pqBobZIwARHpvFJXbFWDma6eUogcCbasRjkjE_fcAndLNooGfhi2b-XY4WLW-W3XXpNOQHndhE5x5x9XAbPXXzLNYNuc7FtWOXyzSdyGiNjz_6f64vr4a573No4IR7OLHTk7NWcXhpUZZBEYQFtU2bVmcb77BpVEYuSXWHk%3D)

The proper study of chemistry helps us understand the world and inspires wonder and awe at the beauty of creation and its Creator.

For these reasons, please join us in helping others gain a greater appreciation for the world around us with **" The Great Principles of Chemistry."**

Let's promote what's true about our world together.

Warm Regards,

Bill Gray, ‘01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

But let’s be honest—our kids aren’t hearing the truth. The media, the left, and even their schools are distorting the facts about these two leaders. If we don’t teach them what real leadership looks like, who will?

body:

One hundred minutes.
That’s how long President Trump spent at the podium Tuesday night, doubling down on his dangerous policies and justifying them with lies. He literally set the record for the longest address to a joint session of Congress – yet he spent just two of those minutes addressing the real kitchen table issues affecting working families.
While some of my colleagues opted to skip the spectacle, I attended with my constituent, Katie Stahl, as a special guest. Katie is a classic DOGE victim, unceremoniously let go last month from her job as a biologist with the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, where she was on probationary status because she received a promotion. She was terminated for being good at her job.
I wanted President Trump to look out at the House gallery and see the Americans he has hurt. As Katie put it, federal workers aren’t data points. They are real people with real families to support. They deserve to be seen and heard.
I’ll never set a record for speech length. But I will continue to give voice to our dedicated civil servants and every American who benefits from the services they provide.

name: Mark Kelly
subject: The American worker needs help
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
I’m backing the PRO Act — so the people putting in long hours day after day can fight back when Trump attacks their rights to organize and get ahead.
#

Team, it's Mark.
My mom getting a union job really changed things for my family. It was a good job, and it meant that if she worked hard, did the right things, our family could really get ahead.
Sadly, that’s not the case for too many people these days.
The American worker is more productive than ever, but the benefits aren’t going back to them or their families. They’re going to people like Elon Musk, or any of the other billionaires at the top of the food chain. They get richer while millions can’t afford to buy a home — or even eggs, right now.
People are working hard, but they can’t achieve their own American Dream. And it’s only getting worse, with President Trump and Republicans in Congress muscling through another tax giveaway that will put even more money in the pockets of the richest people. Trump and Elon are coming after the National Labor Relations Board, too, and that’s going to make it even harder for workers to organize.
I went to the United States Senate to improve things for the people of Arizona. And people at home, they’re worried right now. So, I’ve been looking at what I can do in the Senate to help. America is still the most powerful nation on Earth, and what we do here really matters.
That’s why I’m backing the PRO Act — so the people putting in long hours day after day can fight back when Trump attacks their rights to organize and get ahead. It’s going to protect those workers. It’s going to have a big impact.
[**I’m asking you to join me and add your name as a supporter of the PRO Act. Together, we can move this forward — especially now, with Trump in the White House and Republicans in control of the House and Senate. It matters, so please, sign on.**](https://act.markkelly.com/signup/mek_em_mar25/?source=em250306-1-f&akid=5990%2E6688874%2EWj945e)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.markkelly.com/signup/mek_em_mar25/?source=em250306-1-f&akid=5990%2E6688874%2EWj945e)**
Thank you,
Mark

In his inaugural address, President Donald Trump vowed to end the chronic disease epidemic and keep America’s children healthy and disease-free. An important step begins abroad, pressuring other wealthy countries to abandon policies that restrict access to lifesaving medicines, ensuring chronically ill patients receive the treatments they need. Chronic diseases, such as diabetes, cancer, and cardiovascular disease, pose one of the most significant health threats to Americans today. The share of Americans with multiple chronic conditions increased from 21.8% in 2001 to 27.2% in 2018. In 2022, these illnesses claimed the lives of 1.9 million Americans, accounting for eight out of the 10 leading causes of death. High-quality prescription drugs are among the most effective treatments for chronic diseases. Pharmaceutical products can reduce the severity of patients’ conditions so they can live longer and healthier lives with fewer medical expenses — every dollar spent on medications for diabetes and congestive heart failure can save $3-$10 on emergency room and inpatient hospital visits. A study published in 2022 found that overall, prescription drugs are responsible for 66% of the increase in longevity in the United States between 2006 and 2016. Imagine the difference treatments not yet available might make. ****[****Finish reading on STATnews.com****](http://links.americanxt.com/u/click?_t=45ea7b9dcedb45198104e7ca02a78270&_m=42ae82c67bf042669e7ac17e7e37ee1c&_e=rdIryj1y4z4IJ9bpGEwIpwh6QBgQbTxORZhc4wGw8wrWJ7TtE99X8NRe-Fi-VmvbOhNxLZk4utyMJv1WICMmTekCjM7T1VE5Tlx7CUHzkxZGJGXPpJulbwgI_YarRSHB7RHJCmGZagIndCZXWfQtq__tMH87Xs0YOcittZjpUSJkp9SwDIzgdCo3Kk8pNSDTIvxFwyBf_yiIz3tE8SZCw7u2Iq_GnWDquH-aZVCewcNdeVq-PMK_IyrKv3wcfQJkCz-q3fN5WAUOR1Lx0pIbBOn9xAVGxYX8bvWf3d-HilSEnp6fXUsKsmmtS5gkhfAA)****

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football’s 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville’s time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year’s Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP’s SEC Coach of the Year. _In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

name: Office of U.S. Senator Angela Alsobrooks
subject: Senator Alsobrooks Newsletter -- March 6
body:
|
---
Friends and neighbors, I was at the joint session of Congress this week where I heard the President tell lie after lie after lie. He opened his remarks claiming that "the American Dream is surging bigger and better than before." I was immediately struck by a question: Surging bigger and better for which Americans? Is it the thousands of federal workers who have been fired, scrambling to figure out how they will pay their mortgage or care for their families? Is it veterans who risked their lives for their nation, but are without a job because of this President, or are concerned they will soon lose their benefits because of unelected billionaire Elon Musk's cuts? Is it the seniors who rely on Medicare? The vulnerable who rely on Medicaid? The middle class families who can barely afford groceries? The American people deserve better than this. They deserve the truth. The President went on and on -- it was the longest such speech in history -- and what he wants is for us to get distracted by the rapid fire changes, as opposed to focusing on what he's really trying to do. Friends, we will not be distracted. I want to draw all of our attention to the alarming things he said about Social Security. The President threw out a ton of numbers he said represented deceased individuals who are still getting checks from Social Security. It's a claim that's already been debunked, even by his own new acting Social Security administrator. But it is a claim made with a purpose. This President is fabricating a reason to cut Social Security benefits. Full stop. Now, most Americans have probably been paying into the system since they were teenagers, and this isn't a government handout - it's a safety net that the American people have worked hard to shore up. Social Security isn't a handout. It's a lifeline the American people have EARNED. We see the intention behind the lie. In the Senate, you have my word I will do everything in my power to keep standing up to this President and protect Social Security. **Town Hall** On Tuesday March 11, Senator Chris Van Hollen, Congresswoman Sarah Elfreth, County Executive Calvin Ball, and I will host a town hall regarding our federal civil servants at Howard County Community College. You can join in person or virtually by registering [here.](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14111.5983475.5123050.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fiqconnect.house.gov%2fiqextranet%2fEForm.aspx%3f__cid%3dMD03SE%26__fid%3d100023&redir_log=220826441953515) I know these are difficult times, but please know that I will continue fighting for you every step of the way. We will not give up. We will not give in to this administration, and I ask that you continue to fight alongside us. Please continue to reach out to us. Tell us your story. You can call the office or connect with us at [alsobrooks.senate.gov](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14111.5983475.5123050.7190525&report_id=&redirect=http%3a%2f%2falsobrooks.senate.gov&redir_log=983830187668200). Many of you were asking if we would be on BlueSky, and I'm happy to share that you can now follow us on [Bluesky](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14111.5983475.5123050.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fweb-cdn.bsky.app%2fprofile%2falsobrooks.senate.gov&redir_log=255136950764383), Instagram, Facebook. Threads, YouTube and X. Sincerely, Angela Alsobrooks
United States Senator

Peter,

Tuesday night, Donald Trump stood before Congress and made his intentions clear: _**If he gets his way, democracy as we know it will not survive.**_

body:
Please see a special message from our sponsor:

Unsubscribe
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xul=2qq8ny363wdaxf3eu1ztoj1l9d5qomz1jyfddpjejy0onyqnav32z7n2y6y9lzq73y8whzypjjk2zqhpzn8bajv1f5igheac50oj6zhjo&__stmp=sspl37&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh

Please see a special message from our sponsor:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sspl37&__onlt=t

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6df81tx8nw4yvt31zqdm87osltmc3t8ih73rjvv1fmfz7rszj5bph0q4krdzmmoud0zue71dbaddcm1cp90xj6ounckymzae3mfbcc1q504hmm73wx9vwfi0egs0uiahdgg0off1gfc3tofq8u25a&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sspl37&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sspl37&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sspl37&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sspl37&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6df81tx8nw4yvt31zqdm87oslcjevb0gbl0zp8brst6929dpghj116jxsymclcjjeiwx47x7wdry1y5s825beeke2rhr9wz337wwxwvqdowiex4edz6z7shz2vpmspuro73bby9agadf6gutvrcxi&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sspl37&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sspl37&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Peter Willis,

Trump and the MAGA Movement are in an all out RACE to defund our public
media to silence criticism and stifle dissent:

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21433?t=1061&akid=7803%2E5885482%2EGQRISw ][IMG]

halt all funding for public media. But we are NOT going to let them
control the airwaves....so if MAGA comes with billboards, we’re coming with
the PEOPLE.

National Protect Public Media Day. It’s just the beginning of our massive
push to capture national attention and mobilize record numbers to demand
Congress stand strong.

reject this takeover. But we’re just getting started — can you rush a
donation to help us save NPR and PBS from Trump and Musk?

Musk and Trump have been labeling NPR and PBS as propaganda, demanding
they be defunded and pushing the FCC to launch formal ‘investigations’.
Now, Republicans in Congress are racing to do what Trump says, introducing
bills to defund public media.

It’s all part of Trump and his billionaire backers’ plan to do away with
independent media so that the Oligarchs can spread whatever lies they
like.

Jeff Bezos has jumped on board, telling The Washington Post staff that the
paper would no longer publish views he disagrees with in its opinion
pages. And Bernie is sounding the alarm.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21433?t=1060&akid=7803%2E5885482%2EGQRISw ][IMG]

It’s completely outrageous, but we are NOT powerless. To actually defund
NPR and PBS, Republicans will need almost unanimous support in Congress.
And they’ve tried this before and failed.

We can win this fight. But to do it we are going to have to show up in
massive numbers and leave Congress no choice but to back off. That’s why
Our Revolution is outside of NPR HQ RIGHT NOW, continuing to up the
pressure on Congress to save independent media from Trump.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/21433?t=1054?express_lane=true&amount=22&refcode=email-030625nd&akid=7803%2E5885482%2EGQRISw ]Everything from our Freedom of the Press to our Freedom to Dissent against

up our efforts to save NPR and PBS?

When we organize, we win.

Our Revolution

name: Ken Martin (via Democrats.org)
subject: Sharing an update:
body:
---
Derek, This isn’t a fundraising email. Instead, I want to take a minute to share an update on what Democrats are doing, the DNC’s role in this fight, and how you can get involved right now. Look, we’re all seeing what’s happening: Prices are going up, confidence in the economy is tanking, and a Trump Recession is looming. I was just in Wisconsin and saw eggs being sold for $10.49 (seriously). At the same time, Donald Trump is letting unelected billionaire Elon Musk rip apart the country, fire our veterans, and threaten Social Security. And if that’s not enough, House Republicans just voted to jeopardize health care for millions of people and make it harder for families to put food on the table — all to fund Trump’s massive tax handout to billionaires. Democrats are fighting back — taking legal action against Trump and Musk where possible, voting against Trump’s extreme nominees and legislation, blocking Musk’s DOGE from accessing sensitive data about millions of Americans, and supporting leaders and organizations at the state and local level to protect people in our communities. **But the truth is that we have a lot more work to do to rebuild trust in our Party and show Americans that Democrats are on their side.** That starts with showing up in every community and making our case, listening to people like you, and organizing year-round so that Democrats can truly make an impact _everywhere_ , in all 3,244 counties, and in red, blue, and purple states alike. I’ve already begun traveling across the country to fight for upcoming elections, knock doors, and mobilize a grassroots movement. If we can do this together, we’ll lay the groundwork we need to win local and statewide elections this year, take back Congress in 2026, and ultimately, kick Republicans out of the White House in 2028. That’s the DNC’s job, and that’s what my team and I are hard at work every day. I’m asking for you to stay involved, too — here are two ways you can make an impact right now:
* **Make calls to voters in Wisconsin.** There are critical elections happening here in just a few weeks, and of course, Elon Musk has already gotten involved. [You can help us stop Musk from buying our courts by using this link.](https://ak.democrats.org/go/14275?utm_source=dnc_email%2F%3Frefcode%3Dem_20250306_2908_fr&t=2&akid=2915%2E22930333%2EMiKVg1)
* **Get involved in Florida’s special elections.** Trump has left two congressional seats vacant. These are deep-red seats, but if we show up, we can send a huge message. [Help support the Democrats in these races by clicking here.](https://ak.democrats.org/go/14276?refcode=em_20250306_2908_fr&t=3&akid=2915%2E22930333%2EMiKVg1)

Thank you for everything you’re doing, and I will have more updates to share soon. Ken Ken Martin
Chair
Democratic National Committee | [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-march-2025?amount=3&refcode=em_20250306_2908_fr&refcode2=2915_22930333_MiKVg1&akid=2915%2E22930333%2EMiKVg1)
---

Friends, Look, I know how difficult it is to keep up with Trump’s never-ending news cycle. To constantly hear about the damage and destruction, and the pain and suffering, caused by Trump and his people. To read about our country embarrassing itself, yet again, on the international stage. And then to listen to the same tired reactions from our elected leaders who, like clockwork, express “concern” about the utter insanity that is happening right before our eyes. These are the people who can actually DO something. These are the folks who have been given power by the people to push back and ACT in OUR best interest. And I know that it can sometimes feel hopeless and frustrating. But—we also have power. **And we also must act to make our voices heard.** I am running for Congress to rally the nation to our cause. #
Team — With Elon Musk moving ahead with a radical, illegal takeover of the federal government and budget under Trump’s watch, it’s time for Democrats to use every tool we’ve got to stop their agenda.
[**If that’s all you need to hear, sign our petition calling on Democratic Senators to vote NO on any and all of Trump’s cabinet nominees until Elon Musk is stopped.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/signup/senate_em_march25/?refcode=em250306-1-210&akid=5498%2E196590%2EqZ_IUz)

Since we reached out last month about efforts to block Trump’s cabinet nominations, the movement has gained serious momentum.
Most of Trump’s nominees over the last weeks been confirmed on **_razor thin**_ margins. Even some Republicans are joining the opposition to these unqualified and unfit nominees.
So with three more cabinet positions still to confirm, including the Secretary of Education, we have to keep up the pressure.
Our thinking is simple: If Trump is going to give unlimited power to an unelected billionaire so he can wreak havoc on the lives of working Americans, Democrats shouldn’t enable his adminsitration.
The remedy to this disastrous situation is for Congress to exercise its constitutional duty to put a check on this extreme abuse of power. That’s why we are calling on the Senate to stand up and fight back.
[**Sign on today and help us send a message to Democratic Senators that they must oppose ALL of Trump’s cabinet nominees. subject: Seems like the GOP is afraid to face their voters. I’m not.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
I’m going to start holding “Save Medicaid” town halls in rural Arizona. I’m going to show up in the parts of my state where most of the people voted against me last year, and I’m going to talk to those folks about what the Trump administration, Elon Musk, and Republicans in Congress are doing.
#

Hey everybody, it’s Ruben Gallego.
It’s been kind of stunning to see my colleagues across the aisle running away from the people they represent over the last few weeks.
That doesn’t sit right with me. If they’re too afraid to show up, I will.
I’m going to start holding “Save Medicaid” town halls in rural Arizona. I’m going to show up in the parts of my state where most of the people voted against me last year, and I’m going to talk to those folks about what the Trump administration, Elon Musk, and Republicans in Congress are doing.
[**If that’s something you can get behind and you’d like to chip in to help out, please: Make a donation of whatever you can afford to my campaign.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-mar25.cQPUMp&refcode=em250306-1-f&t=1&akid=3747%2E734936%2Et9qIpZ)
[CHIP IN](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-mar25.cQPUMp&refcode=em250306-1-f&t=2&akid=3747%2E734936%2Et9qIpZ)
People are pissed, and for good reason. Elon Musk and Donald Trump are taking a chainsaw to the federal government. They’re firing thousands of workers, including at least 6000 veterans so far. The VA is under attack, Social Security is at risk, and Republicans in the House just passed a budget resolution with $880 billion in cuts to Medicaid in it.
And, it’s weird — we saw all of them cheering Trump on at his joint address to the House and Senate on Tuesday night. They’re clearly on board. Why are they so scared to talk to their voters about it?
I think I know: More than two million Arizonans are enrolled in Medicaid, and millions more around the country depend on it. Republicans are scared of these town halls because they’re going to rip health care away from millions of people to pass trillions of dollars in tax breaks for the richest people in the country.
The way we’re going to stop them is by increasing the volume. We’ve got to make this hurt — and that means we’ve got to get out and tell people what Trump, Elon, and the GOP are trying to do.
That’s why I’m heading out to rural Arizona for these “Save Medicaid” town halls. To face the people I represent, and drive that message home.
[**It’d mean a lot to have your support when I’m out there. A donation of $5 or $10 is going to add up fast if tons of folks chip in. Can I count on you?**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-mar25.cQPUMp&refcode=em250306-1-f&t=3&akid=3747%2E734936%2Et9qIpZ)

clean_body: Grassroots organizing to save Medicaid | = | Big news: We are partnering with organized labor across the state to launch a grassroots campaign to make sure EVERYONE knows about the GOP’s plan to cut Medicaid. It’s critically important that voters in swing seats across California know that Republicans are planning to pay for billionaire tax cuts by taking the axe to healthcare for the poorest Americans. That’s why we are launching a mobilization campaign to get the word out ASAP. = = Here’s the deal: House Republicans who represent large numbers of Americans using Medicaid are nervous about their leaders’ plans to slash billions in funding for the lifesaving program. That’s why we are working with organized labor to put the pressure on Republicans in vulnerable districts to NOT support this terrible plan. And according to Politico’s reporting, this work might already be paying off! “Rep. Valadao’s central California district is perennially in play — Valadao is in his sixth term but lost one in the middle — and more than 3 in 5 of his constituents, more than 470,000 people, rely on Medicaid, according to NYU Langone Health’s estimate. He was among six Republican representatives and two territorial delegates who recently signed a letter to Speaker Mike Johnson warning that ‘slashing Medicaid would have serious consequences, particularly in rural and predominantly Hispanic communities.’” That’s why we need to keep the heat turned up. We have big plans to make phone calls and reach voters in key districts about this. But our budget for this type of pressure campaign is very limited. Fellow patriot,

I recently introduced a bill in the U.S. Senate that would finally declare English as the official language of the United States.

It’s just common sense–but the radical left had a _meltdown_ , calling me a racist and a bigot.

But as one of the only naturalized citizens serving in the U.S. Senate, **I am here to tell you Americans don’t have to be ashamed of our culture.**

When I moved here legally with my family from Colombia at age five, I didn’t speak a word of English.

But I was determined to master the language because it was clear to me that this was the whole reason my family came here— _to become Americans._

**The proudest moment of my life was becoming an American citizen at age 18, a process that showed me just how foundational the English language is to the American way of life.**

clean_body: Americans should not be ashamed of our culture, and I am grateful to President Trump for his resolute action on this issue. | Did you see it, fellow patriot? While my bill to make English the official language of the United States has been pending in the Senate, President Trump stepped in and just got it done by signing an Executive Order! Americans should not be ashamed of our culture, and I am grateful to President Trump for his resolute action on this issue. But I still want to know if you agree... Should English be our official language? -Senator Moreno From: Sen. Bernie Moreno Date: Thursday, February 20, 2025 To: dpwillis67@gmail.com Subject: English the official language? Fellow patriot, I recently introduced a bill in the U.S. Senate that would finally declare English as the official language of the United States. It’s just common sense–but the radical left had a meltdown , calling me a racist and a bigot. But as one of the only naturalized citizens serving in the U.S. Senate, I am here to tell you Americans don’t have to be ashamed of our culture. When I moved here legally with my family from Colombia at age five, I didn’t speak a word of English. But I was determined to master the language because it was clear to me that this was the whole reason my family came here— to become Americans. The proudest moment of my life was becoming an American citizen at age 18, a process that showed me just how foundational the English language is to the American way of life. It’s long past time that we enshrine this simple fact into law. Please weigh in as the Senate debates this issue. Thank you! name: Tom Fitton
subject: Who Should be Voting in American Elections?
body:
The integrity of our elections is being gutted by liberal politicians and other public officials who refuse to honor the principle that ONLY AMERICAN CITIZENS SHOULD BE ALLOWED TO VOTE IN AMERICAN ELECTIONS!

| | |
---
|
---
|
---
| Dear Fellow American,

The integrity of our elections is being gutted by liberal politicians and other public officials who refuse to honor the principle that **ONLY AMERICAN CITIZENS SHOULD BE ALLOWED TO VOTE IN AMERICAN ELECTIONS!**
And **Judicial Watch** is what stands between preserving honest elections and letting the Radical Left open our voting boots to illegal aliens and potentially stealing elections.
[We have the proven track record and the legal expertise to win...but we need your help!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=72694&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=72694&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

I am not exaggerating about non-citizens voting in our elections...recently states including **Massachusetts, Ohio and Virginia** have all removed non-citizens from their voter rolls (after finding that many of those non-citizens had already voted).

"Dirty" voter rolls make it easier for non-citizens to vote, and that's why we have filed successful lawsuits and other legal actions against multiple states, cities and counties across the country, leading to the _removal of**well over 4 million** ineligible voters from voter rolls_!

But our elections are under _steady_ assault by a huge coalition of left-wing forces, many funded by radical billionaire **George Soros** , promoted by the **Mainstream Media** and supported by **liberal politicians** ... _and they all want to take back power by corrupting our elections with the votes of non-citizens_!

That's why our fight for honest elections...through voter roll lawsuits, investigations of voting procedures, lawsuits challenging state efforts to "extend" Election Day, and actions in support of President Trump's efforts to end illegal immigration...is so vitally important.

**[And I am counting on you to once again help us with a contribution today, because the investigative and legal work of fighting for ballot integrity on all fronts is both _constant_ and _expensive_!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=72694&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)**

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=72694&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

I believe that preserving honest elections... _and the principle that only eligible American citizens should be allowed to vote in them_ ...is essential to the preservation of our Republic. I am sure that as an informed and concerned American, you do, too.

So I hope I can count on you to give us your support today.

And I thank you, in advance, for deciding to help Judicial Watch and our mission of upholding the rule of law.

Thomas Fitton
President

Just like all the ones before it – and no doubt all the ones to come – Trump's address to Congress referenced countless false numbers, bragged about his continued whitewashing of our Government, and made far-off claims that have no truth to them.

Here's just a few of the outright lies that he spread the other night:
**TRUMP’S LIE:** DOGE has saved us billions of dollars in spending.
**THE REALITY:** He and his second-in-command, Elon Musk, have provided NO documentation showing contracts they've canceled. They've also laid off about 30,000 federal workers in the process.

**TRUMP’S LIE:** Under Trump's authority, House Republicans have passed a bill to save $880 million in the federal budget.
**THE REALITY:** These "savings" come at the expense of gutting Medicaid – which would leave millions of Americans without adequate healthcare.

**TRUMP’S LIE:** Tariffs will help our economy by bringing in trillions of dollars.

| | Dear Reader,

Love him or hate him... Bill O’Reilly always manages to get people’s attention.

A short time ago... he got mine.

I’ve known him for years... he’s been a reader of mine and has become a good friend.

But recently he told me...

**“I came away from that cabinet meeting believing Trump is perhaps the best prepared new president in history.”**

subject: This is your wake up call

body:
We are officially less than 100 days out from Election Day in New Jersey.
Peter,
We are officially less than 100 days out from Election Day in New Jersey. In campaign world, 100 days is sort of a milestone — we’re in that critical time period where races are won or lost.
**So consider this your wake-up call:**
If you care about making life easier and more affordable for New Jersey families, this is your wake-up call.
If you know we need to keep the governor’s seat out of Republican hands, this is your wake-up call.
If you think we need to send a clear message to Donald Trump, Elon Musk, and their Republican friends that we won’t stand for their disastrous power grab, *this* is your wake-up call.
**The time to stand up for what we believe in isn’t in 2026 or 2028 — it’s right now.**
**But with less than 100 days to go, 52% of voters are still undecided, and some of Mikie’s supporters are still on the sidelines.**
**Mikie will work harder than anyone to talk to voters across all 21 counties, but she can’t do it alone.**

The Department of Revenue will provide tax preparation assistance for taxpayers in libraries across Oregon. **What you will need to bring:**
* Social security card or individual tax identification number for everyone on your tax return
* Government picture ID for taxpayer and spouse if filing jointly (driver's license or passport)
* Forms W-2 (wages from a job)
* Forms 1099-G, 1099-R, 1099 INT (other income)
* Form SSA-1099 (Social Security benefits)
* Canceled check or bank routing and account number for direct deposit
* Last year's tax return

**Dates and Locations:**
* **March 11th- Toledo Public Library 10 AM- 5 PM**
* **March 18th- Coquille Public Library 10 AM- 1 PM**
* **March 19th- Bandon Public Library 9 AM- 5:30 PM**
* **March 20th- North Bend Public Library 10 AM- 6 PM**
* **March 21st- Coquille Public Library 10 AM- 2 PM**

**More information can be found[HERE](https://links-2.govdelivery.com/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.oregon.gov%2Fdor%2Fprograms%2Findividuals%2FPages%2Ffree-direct-file.aspx/1/010101956ca4d020-f19a594f-609c-4938-812b-c4527276cfc3-000000/uZ5d3b2aIAqY5KWl_eacnXktW1Ps8UQJZeWicB4AAF4=395)** |

body:
| Peter,

The Trump Administration's proposed cuts to the National Institute of Health would be a disastrous rollback in funding that could hinder scientific progress for years to come.

| | **_Meet Rob:_** Rob Bresnahan is a fifth generation Northeastern Pennsylvanian serving his first term in Congress as the Representative for Pennsylvania’s 8th Congressional District. A product of the American Dream, Rob learned the true meaning of hard work at an early age. He learned the ins and outs of the electrical industry by wiring junction boxes, running heavy equipment, driving trucks, and getting his hands dirty. In the process, he learned about the real-world challenges facing America’s blue-collar workers. At just 19 years old, Rob joined his family’s business as the CFO for Kuharchik Construction. He became the CEO of the company in 2013. The sole member of the National Electrical Contractors Association serving in the People’s House, Rob spent over a decade working and connecting with blue-collar Americans across the country before running for Congress in 2024. He’s learned exactly how far-left energy policies coming out of Washington have strangled the American energy sector. And sadly, he’s seen the destructive impacts these policies have had on Pennsylvania’s blue-collar workers first-hand. But the people of Northeastern Pennsylvania demanded change in November 2024 when they sent Rob to Congress. Through his work in Washington, Rob is 100% devoted to restoring America’s energy independence, deregulating the economy, and bringing well-paying jobs back to our great commonwealth.

Peter, Earlier this week, Governor Kotek brought together affordable housing advocates, homebuilders, and local businesses to help address Oregon’s housing crisis. Everyone joined to highlight Governor Kotek’s latest bill, HB 2138, which would legalize more housing across the state, cut red tape, and expand incentives for affordable and accessible housing statewide. _The Oregon Home Builders Association praised the initiative, saying, "Governor Kotek is making it easier to build those homes."_ _“[Advocacy groups] added that the bill will help people live closer to essential services by removing local building barriers.”_ _“Governor Kotek’s bill builds on Bend’s success expanding support for cottage clusters, ADUs and small-scale developments across the state.”_ Governor Kotek’s bill to expand middle housing will have an immediate impact on Oregonians, like Hillary Gray, a retired nurse from Portland, who spoke at Monday’s press conference. Friend, This week, a federal judge extended her court order to block Trump’s attempt to fire nearly all staff at the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau—the federal agency that protects working people from corporations that seek to rip us off. **This is an important temporary win at a crucial time:** **I worked closely with the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau to remove $50 billion in medical debt from 15 million Americans’ credit reports, which should go into effect**** _this month_****.** Last year I hosted the Director of the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) for a round table in Michigan about the crushing impact of medical debt on families. We heard directly from residents in my Congressional district, including one woman who had to navigate “astounding” medical bills after her husband was diagnosed with the terminal illness known as ALS. Medical debt is the leading cause of bankruptcy in our country, and many families lose their homes or struggle to access necessities like housing or transportation because of debt collections listed on their credit report. Imagine being denied housing while wrestling with a major medical issue and mounting bills. This is unconscionable. That’s why, since my first few months in Congress,**I’ve fought to ban medical debt from appearing on credit reports.** I passed this legislation in the House of Representatives but it wasn’t signed into law, so I worked with the CFPB to get it done. **I’ve also co-led legislation to end medical debt altogether** with Congresspeople like Senator Bernie Sanders, and as a member of the Medicare for All Caucus **I’ve co-sponsored legislation to secure universal high-quality healthcare for all**. I will never stop fighting for the majority of Americans who live paycheck to paycheck and can’t afford expenses like medical emergencies. I will keep demanding changes to our profit-driven healthcare system, which is killing thousands of Americans each year because they can’t afford healthcare. Even among adults who have health insurance coverage, 1 in 5 have skipped medical treatment because of concerns about cost. While continuing to push back against corporate greed, I will also continue defending the much-needed relief we won for 15 million Americans who can access more economic opportunities without medical bills on their credit reports. I will also keep pushing to expand life-saving programs like Medicaid and Medicare, to lower and cap healthcare costs, to secure Medicare for All, to end medical debt, and more. [**Will you chip in $5 or more today to help defend the programs our communities rely on AND build the society we deserve, where instead of fighting for scraps we all have access to healthcare and other life-saving needs?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsbJvjj203tPYjMhOk2UTl_OrC0RCN787aB0qTIEGsn53v_VkPc_cmJR76--2kLFvt_IDW36yS73YZIFTT4tW486plt51YIUZ3gWXQtdByALoZIOnoBuMdxdHXQi7apSXuv1VMD5dw8tGMK2m9vsq9rZasRSJiEmFoqgSWLPsb89vO7Rf5lbiRhBtesgym_6aFZFDUXK_M4MzcxSCX698gfpEdvVAD4_M_Ju4gMCuij9E8swYJqzr4TJfWDlysgVauoFykHTekN_tYcmsRttqeN89q2C0FqWKISRNNx_QgV0IhnNd3iIWFEpUdZUC4q79v9MZLTWS--Sn_CkAK1iwrU6Nd30WV2ca-5s-_dMREdzA/4ek/TsRojPI1QJS2-R22vdUdkw/h1/h001.ONa53ZqMLs0uy8ifxc-B8yDzylZnNiWrGNYhVnN8xUc) | [CHIP IN](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsbJvjj203tPYjMhOk2UTl_OrC0RCN787aB0qTIEGsn51WK0y4pHSdJePjXU8jP8fgosxATFtsFUs4fuMamEgHMJCkYHxLzE-44JzSn1X7DVFw4CdYXFN1SQKwL3xseAUVNBbsO4NdB23vd0bHGP8_83TKTppPtDevZwcSVxXZRhJljEHX8xBvaRUnZG3KiTKLiIuyrz_tJRjOP8MmZX5nREs0zngQWc3gNlP1-f3a4Ced5ifbALbxU6MYaCbVlztAUo2r_gIdAo0C2xZHhNBnfqvkVYtEPkxMJ6PXm9Et6gw0IySI5hadr2qxP7fr3IWwVE--WAPpl1nwF77NV-1sAYCCRTRJCBH0HhKqZOQL45g/4ek/TsRojPI1QJS2-R22vdUdkw/h2/h001.ElHqWbeCMgr4Otn4JMj-l1m6EjB74CpQ-VheX1009p8)

Last month I held a town hall in my district about erasing medical debt and the pathway to Medicare for All, where organizational leaders and public health experts shared their experiences fighting for universal healthcare.
[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsbJvjj203tPYjMhOk2UTl_OrC0RCN787aB0qTIEGsn5wULwUaWJ0JDdGzg3dOuQ6x1XvOER89tRHNFsdkIJYXeQU6lzlIjHXwxLF4s6p_FkDmq0tjdC737DZUe4krAEx3E-U31-yuM0GPYYJcIWNUXN5wIhmT1fI6fm-l6obrg0ds0o9hw-GfJZGu52on7gJfKDpmz_n7lHo_R9lCviYFeXENzDtK15nNnhlzblEu8P456Ql2FKpO4qcMDpZnPre-WJ09Dlv5mUyYzgf79poz1gxOdOdyV27s2jIClj_giELKSHmePzu-gvG_yTEg5Wh9-PBgyQEPB-pCXxtHG7pEyVE-RMfZd90jYEm_I7KzXjQ/4ek/TsRojPI1QJS2-R22vdUdkw/h3/h001.eKRNFwhZ4TicoQsWSGZrPuxM02eqgA6Yg2hD2WbW3Ak)
Without Medicare for All, millions of people lack coverage, while expenses continue to rise. We all deserve so much better than a broken healthcare system that profits off of sickness and leaves more than 20 million people without health insurance. We deserve a system that guarantees healthcare as a human right.
**I will keep pushing for a society where all of us can thrive, and I will keep pushing back against right-wing threats to steal from us in order to pay for****huge tax breaks for billionaires and powerful corporations.**
For example, I voted _no_ and spoke out against the Republican budget framework passed last week by the U.S. House of Representatives. I’m continuing to stay loud about how it’s disgraceful that Republicans and unelected billionaires are trying to dismantle the taxpayer-funded social services that our communities rely on.
Everyday people continue to speak up as well. GOP members of Congress keep hearing from their upset constituents across political parties after taking actions like voting to cut the state-federal health insurance program known as Medicaid. Polls show strong bipartisan support for lowering and capping healthcare costs, with 84% of Republicans in favor of canceling medical debt. Most support Medicaid as well.
**Medicaid covers 1 in 5 Americans—including 60% of all nursing home residents and nearly 40% of all children. However, many people may not realize that their healthcare is covered by Medicaid, because Medicaid is called a variety of names depending on what state you live in.**
In my state of Michigan, for example, our Medicaid program is called Medical Assistance. The organization MoveOn made this graphic that names Medicaid in each state:
_(Note: States like Indiana and Minnesota have multiple names for Medicaid programs, so this is not an exhaustive list. After posting, MoveOn made a correction that Medicaid is known as NC Medicaid in North Carolina.)_
While Congress was on recess last week, I held a town hall in my district about advocating to protect federal programs and our communities. We had a panel with nonprofit groups MoveOn, Indivisible, and Democracy Forward to provide action items for residents who want to help educate, organize, and resist the attacks on vital federal programs and services.
People showed up across the country at town halls last week, which is an important way to push your Senators and your Representative in the U.S. House. When many Republican Congresspeople fail to listen to their constituents’ demands for them to hold town halls in their districts, Americans are showing up in protest anyway.
At least one Republican Senator shamefully left in the middle of a town hall last week, which was packed with his constituents who were upset about cuts to federal programs like the Department of Veteran Affairs.
We know that too many leaders in our government are ignoring or are completely out of touch with the people they’re supposed to represent. I’m pushing to change that because we deserve a real democracy that helps everyone thrive. Will you join me?

clean_body: While defending programs like Medicaid, let’s also keep pushing for transformative changes like Medicare for All. | | | Friend, This week, a federal judge extended her court order to block Trump’s attempt to fire nearly all staff at the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau—the federal agency that protects working people from corporations that seek to rip us off. This is an important temporary win at a crucial time: I worked closely with the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau to remove $50 billion in medical debt from 15 million Americans’ credit reports, which should go into effect this month. Last year I hosted the Director of the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) for a round table in Michigan about the crushing impact of medical debt on families. We heard directly from residents in my Congressional district, including one woman who had to navigate “astounding” medical bills after her husband was diagnosed with the terminal illness known as ALS. Medical debt is the leading cause of bankruptcy in our country, and many families lose their homes or struggle to access necessities like housing or transportation because of debt collections listed on their credit report. Imagine being denied housing while wrestling with a major medical issue and mounting bills. This is unconscionable. That’s why, since my first few months in Congress,I’ve fought to ban medical debt from appearing on credit reports. I passed this legislation in the House of Representatives but it wasn’t signed into law, so I worked with the CFPB to get it done. I’ve also co-led legislation to end medical debt altogether with Congresspeople like Senator Bernie Sanders, and as a member of the Medicare for All Caucus I’ve co-sponsored legislation to secure universal high-quality healthcare for all. I will never stop fighting for the majority of Americans who live paycheck to paycheck and can’t afford expenses like medical emergencies. I will keep demanding changes to our profit-driven healthcare system, which is killing thousands of Americans each year because they can’t afford healthcare. Even among adults who have health insurance coverage, 1 in 5 have skipped medical treatment because of concerns about cost. While continuing to push back against corporate greed, I will also continue defending the much-needed relief we won for 15 million Americans who can access more economic opportunities without medical bills on their credit reports. I will also keep pushing to expand life-saving programs like Medicaid and Medicare, to lower and cap healthcare costs, to secure Medicare for All, to end medical debt, and more. | Last month I held a town hall in my district about erasing medical debt and the pathway to Medicare for All, where organizational leaders and public health experts shared their experiences fighting for universal healthcare. Without Medicare for All, millions of people lack coverage, while expenses continue to rise. We all deserve so much better than a broken healthcare system that profits off of sickness and leaves more than 20 million people without health insurance. We deserve a system that guarantees healthcare as a human right. I will keep pushing for a society where all of us can thrive, and I will keep pushing back against right-wing threats to steal from us in order to pay forhuge tax breaks for billionaires and powerful corporations. For example, I voted no and spoke out against the Republican budget framework passed last week by the U.S. House of Representatives. I’m continuing to stay loud about how it’s disgraceful that Republicans and unelected billionaires are trying to dismantle the taxpayer-funded social services that our communities rely on. Everyday people continue to speak up as well. GOP members of Congress keep hearing from their upset constituents across political parties after taking actions like voting to cut the state-federal health insurance program known as Medicaid. Polls show strong bipartisan support for lowering and capping healthcare costs, with 84% of Republicans in favor of canceling medical debt. Most support Medicaid as well. Medicaid covers 1 in 5 Americans—including 60% of all nursing home residents and nearly 40% of all children. However, many people may not realize that their healthcare is covered by Medicaid, because Medicaid is called a variety of names depending on what state you live in. In my state of Michigan, for example, our Medicaid program is called Medical Assistance. The organization MoveOn made this graphic that names Medicaid in each state: (Note: States like Indiana and Minnesota have multiple names for Medicaid programs, so this is not an exhaustive list. After posting, MoveOn made a correction that Medicaid is known as NC Medicaid in North Carolina.) While Congress was on recess last week, I held a town hall in my district about advocating to protect federal programs and our communities. We had a panel with nonprofit groups MoveOn, Indivisible, and Democracy Forward to provide action items for residents who want to help educate, organize, and resist the attacks on vital federal programs and services. People showed up across the country at town halls last week, which is an important way to push your Senators and your Representative in the U.S. House. When many Republican Congresspeople fail to listen to their constituents’ demands for them to hold town halls in their districts, Americans are showing up in protest anyway. At least one Republican Senator shamefully left in the middle of a town hall last week, which was packed with his constituents who were upset about cuts to federal programs like the Department of Veteran Affairs. We know that too many leaders in our government are ignoring or are completely out of touch with the people they’re supposed to represent. I’m pushing to change that because we deserve a real democracy that helps everyone thrive. Will you join me? clean_body: | The climate crisis is still ongoing, team. But of course, you already knew that. We’re just two months into the new year, but we’ve already seen dramatic weather all over the country. The deep south got snow just a few weeks ago. And you can bet this summer is going to be hotter than ever. So it doesn’t make sense that Donald Trump and Elon Musk are threatening the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA). | Trump and Elon have always bowed down to Big Oil. Now, over 1,000 EPA employees have been told to stay home and prepare to be “fired immediately” so the fossil fuel industry can wreak even more havoc on our environment. Worse yet, the programs being dismantled are responsible for measuring the impact of burning fossil fuels. Weakening the EPA will only hurt working Americans — especially Black and Brown communities that are already vulnerable to the worst parts of the climate crisis. Our communities deserve clean air and fresh water, not Big Oil’s filth. But unless we speak up, the EPA will be completely gutted and filled with Trump and Elon’s fossil fuel buddies. We can’t let that happen. | Thanks for standing up for climate action 🌱 NextGen America | | = |

Voter Action Project
Folks,
Donald Trump is attempting an illegal takeover of the United States Postal Service by firing the entire Postal Board of Governors and placing the USPS directly under the control of billionaire Trump donor Howard Lutnick, recently sworn in as Secretary of Commerce. Trump described it as a “ type of merger .”
But here’s the truth, the Postal Service is not a private business and it doesn’t belong to Trump or the White House, it belongs to the American people.
This isn't the first time we've faced such a threat. We've stopped Trump before, from privatization efforts in 2018 to attempted sabotage before the 2020 elections. Now we must stop Trump's unconstitutional power grab and keep the Postal Service in public hands, where it belongs.
Demand that the Postal Board of Governors to refuse Trump's illegal order, stand strong, stay on the job, and save the Post Office >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/stop-trumps-illegal-usps-takeover?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.everyaction.com%2F9bivrSvjFEim0QMMvgcQrA2]
SIGN HERE NOW ⇨ [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/stop-trumps-illegal-usps-takeover?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.everyaction.com%2F9bivrSvjFEim0QMMvgcQrA2]
This move is unconstitutional and blatantly illegal.
In 1970, Congress passed the Postal Reorganization Act , explicitly removing the Postal Service from presidential control . They established the USPS as an independent, self-funded public agency. Trump's executive order would blatantly violate the law and undermine the separation of powers essential to our democracy. The Postal Board of Governors must reject this unlawful attempt by refusing Trump's firing order, and stay on the job to fight back.
If Trump is successful, postal workers, seniors, and rural Americans will bear the brunt of the devastating consequences. Over 640,000 dedicated postal employees, including 73,000 veterans, will see their livelihoods jeopardized . Rural communities risk losing guaranteed delivery of medication, Social Security checks, ballots, and other essential mail.
Trump's illegal plan would pave the way for a possible privatization of our public postal system by chopping up USPS, selling off its parts, and putting profit margins over public service.
Together with our diverse coalition of labor unions, veterans, voting rights advocates, civil rights groups, and grassroots activists across the nation, we've protected our Postal Service and we can and will do it again.

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: Don’t tune out
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
How do we save democracy? Don’t tune out
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=2252%2E135344%2EnSjHnE)

Hi everyone -
I’ve heard from so many of you who want to know how we move forward in this political climate. But how do we actually do that?
**First, don’t tune out.** It’s easy to be exhausted, but America needs you now more than ever. If previous generations had not fought for democracy, where would we be today?
**Second, hold your elected officials, including me, accountable.** Watch how they’re voting. Go to town halls and demand they take action. That’s as American as apple pie.
**Third, organize.** Pick just one issue you’re passionate about — and engage. And doom scrolling doesn’t count. Join a group that cares about your issue, and act. And if you can’t find one, start one.
Some of the most important movements in our history have come from the bottom up.
We all know that our country is going through something right now. We’re not sure what the next day is going to hold, let alone the next decade.
But this isn’t the first time we’ve experienced significant and tumultuous change as a country. I’m a student of history, and we’ve gone through periods of political instability before. And ultimately, we’ve chosen to keep changing this country for the better.
But every single time, we’ve only gotten through those moments because of two things: Engaged citizens and principled leaders.
Engaged citizens who do a little bit more than they’re used to doing to fight for the things they care about. And principled leaders who are ready to receive the ball and do something about it.
