Friends,
Workers across Colorado and the country deserve fair wages, safe working conditions, and the right to organize without fear. I was proud to stand with the hardworking employees of King Soopers and members of the United Food and Commercial Workers Union (UFCW) as they fought for better pay and protections on the job earlier this month.
https://secure.ngpvan.com/5hK3_mAVkECom-YCanLgIA2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/5hK3_mAVkECom-YCanLgIA2]
Unions are the backbone of the middle class. Our communities are stronger when workers have a seat at the table. Corporate greed cannot come before the dignity of those who keep our stores running, stock our shelves, and ensure families have the food they need.
I’m glad that the strike is now over and that officials are returning to the bargaining table.
Will you add your name to show your support for workers’ rights and fair labor practices? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/5hK3_mAVkECom-YCanLgIA2]
Sign the Petition [https://secure.ngpvan.com/5hK3_mAVkECom-YCanLgIA2]Every signature sends a message: Colorado stands with workers.
Thank you for standing with me, with UFCW, and with all those fighting for a fair deal.
In solidarity,
Jena Griswold

clean_body: [] Friends, Workers across Colorado and the country deserve fair wages, safe working conditions, and the right to organize without fear. I was proud to stand with the hardworking employees of King Soopers and members of the United Food and Commercial Workers Union (UFCW) as they fought for better pay and protections on the job earlier this month. [] Unions are the backbone of the middle class. Our communities are stronger when workers have a seat at the table. Corporate greed cannot come before the dignity of those who keep our stores running, stock our shelves, and ensure families have the food they need. I’m glad that the strike is now over and that officials are returning to the bargaining table. Will you add your name to show your support for workers’ rights and fair labor practices? subject: We are making progress
body:
President Trump laid out a common sense agenda on Tuesday night | | | [](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=67c9f7f64d310c639aa067db&u=https%3A%2F%2Ftombarrettforcongress.com%2F%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D67c85917ede83a0497cad705%26ss_email_id%3D67c9f7f64d310c639aa067db%26ss_campaign_name%3DWe%2Bare%2Bmaking%2Bprogress%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2025-03-06T19%253A31%253A34Z&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_67c85917ede83a0497cad705&l=en-US&s=eUNF5ylYaMrBdd-pnzVgAsiMpfQ%3D)
---
| Peter Willis, Tuesday night, President Trump addressed Congress, touting the successes of his first six weeks in office, as well as laying out a common sense agenda for the country.Since taking the Oath of Office on January 20th, President Trump and Republicans in Congress have moved decisively and delivered the wins promised during the campaign.
---
[_ _**Join the Fight** _ _](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=67c9f7f64d310c639aa067db&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Fsotu&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_67c85917ede83a0497cad705&l=en-US&s=jvEMU1hygi0Y4dRzJNNQxpsFcp0%3D)
---
|
---
We’ve **strengthened the border** and begun deportations, resulting in a 25 year low in illegal border crossings.We’ve **banned men from playing women’s sports** , protecting Title IX, making sure female athletes are safe, and that they have the opportunities they deserve.And in spite of a fiery meeting in the Oval Office, **Ukraine will sign a mineral rights agreement** with the United States, allowing American taxpayers to recoup some of the billions they’ve sent to the embattled country since the war began three years ago.
---
[_ _**I Want to Help** _ _](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=67c9f7f64d310c639aa067db&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Fsotu&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_67c85917ede83a0497cad705&l=en-US&s=jvEMU1hygi0Y4dRzJNNQxpsFcp0%3D)
---
* We spend $2 Trillion more each year than we take in
* We spend $1 Trillion each year on interest payments alone
* Our National Debit is now more than $36 Trillion

**This is unsustainable.** We are taking tough stands on behalf of the American people, and we have the permanent establishment and corporate media doing everything they can to stop us.
---
[_ _**Stand with Tom** _ _](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=67c9f7f64d310c639aa067db&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Fsotu&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_67c85917ede83a0497cad705&l=en-US&s=jvEMU1hygi0Y4dRzJNNQxpsFcp0%3D)
---
These stands are drawing attacks from groups funded by George Soros, who are already organizing protests at my office, and now spending money on attack ads - **more than a year and a half from the next election!**
---
|
---
|
---
[**Please consider making a donation to help me defend my seat and continue the important work to Make America Great Again.**](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=67c9f7f64d310c639aa067db&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Fsotu&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_67c85917ede83a0497cad705&l=en-US&s=jvEMU1hygi0Y4dRzJNNQxpsFcp0%3D) Any amount helps and I am grateful for your support,
---
|
---
[_ _ Defend Tom _ _](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=67c9f7f64d310c639aa067db&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Ftom-barrett-for-congress%2Fsotu&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_67c85917ede83a0497cad705&l=en-US&s=jvEMU1hygi0Y4dRzJNNQxpsFcp0%3D)

| | Peter – This is a long email, but I hope you’ll keep reading. On Tuesday night, President Trump delivered his first address to a joint session of Congress since taking office 6 weeks ago. Honestly, I debated whether or not to attend, given Trump’s brazen disrespect for Congress.

Ultimately, I decided that attending was the best way to clearly demonstrate the devastating impacts his administration’s DOGE cuts have on communities like ours.

My guest for the address was Dr. Jim Brewer, a medical professor and chair of UC San Diego’s Department of Neurosciences, the top National Institutes of Health (NIH)-funded neuroscience department in the country – **where he leads critical and life-saving research on Alzheimer’s disease.**

**Under the Trump Administration’s proposed NIH funding cuts – $800 million in California alone – Dr. Brewer’s patients will lose access to clinical trials for potentially life-changing treatments, families will lose hope for their affected loved ones, and research on the cusp of finding cures will come to a halt.**

These cuts will cost lives, hurt the broader economy, and jeopardize America’s position as a world leader in science and innovation.

What’s especially frustrating is that this is being done under the false pretense of “cutting waste.” You know what’s actually wasteful? Throwing out the results of clinical trials made possible by the investments of taxpayers.

It’s short-sighted and wildly harmful.

Our district receives nearly $1 billion in NIH grant funding every year, which is more than any other district in California. San Diego is home to world-class public and private research institutions and private companies that have propelled the field forward, turning discoveries into therapies and cures.

The biotech industry and medical research institutions like Dr. Brewer’s department at UCSD have deep roots in our community and have long provided care and services on which many San Diegans rely. We can’t afford to lose that, NAME.

Peter, rest assured that I will use every tool at my disposal in Congress to protect our communities and fight back against Trump’s dangerous agenda.

Thanks for standing with me.

– Scott

Hi Derek. Senator Elissa Slotkin here.
Earlier this week, I gave the official response to President Trump’s Joint Address. I hope you had a chance to watch.
Since I’m a stranger to most people who don’t follow politics, I introduced myself and just kept it straight with the people watching about the moment we are in right now.
We just went through another fraught election season. Americans made it clear that they want change. But there is a responsible way to make change, and a reckless way. And, we can make that change without forgetting who we are as a country, and as a democracy.
Because no matter where you live, most Americans share three core beliefs: That the middle class is the engine of our country. That strong national security protects us from harm. And that our democracy, no matter how messy, is unparalleled and worth fighting for.
We all know that our country is going through something right now. We’re not sure what the next day is going to hold, let alone the next decade.
But this isn’t the first time we’ve experienced this as a country. Every single time, we’ve gotten through those moments because of two things: Engaged citizens and principled leaders.
If you're with me in that fight, I have an ask of you:

The Wall Street Journal is reporting that Donald Trump is expected to issue an Executive Order (EO) instructing former WWE promoter and current Secretary of Education Linda McMahon to shut down the Department of Education (DOE). This move is both unconstitutional and catastrophic for America's students. And while Trump's supporters will likely cheer this as an attack on "big government," the reality is much darker: this is a direct assault on our children and teachers, on educational equity and access, and serves as a major giveaway to billionaires. **Let 's Address This.**
**Quick Ask!** I am doing everything in my power to stave off fascism in the United States, and I need your support. **Subscribe and join more than 122,000 fellow activists.**

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c1d3fda9-e2cd-4499-a6f7-62da8884d941?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

## An Executive Order Cannot Undo Legislation
Let's start with the basics--Trump either doesn't understand or doesn't care about how the law works (probably a combination of both). The Department of Education was not created by executive order. It was established through legislation passed by Congress. Specifically, in 1979, President Jimmy Carter signed the Department of Education Organization Act, which elevated education to a Cabinet-level priority. This move ensured that the federal government could provide equal access to education, enforce civil rights protections, and allocate resources to schools in need. Therefore, while Trump cannot actually dissolve the Department of Education, he can still cause immense harm by defunding it, and effectively making it useless. It is important we understand how devastating these spending cuts will actually be.
## Trump's EO Will Harm Low Income and Black and Brown Children The Most
Irrespective of a formal shutdown of the DOE, Trump's attacks on public education are devastating to the futures of tens of millions of children by denying them equal access. In fact, the top line mission of the Department of Education is:
1. _to strengthen the Federal commitment to ensuring access to equal educational opportunity for every individual;_

Before the DOE existed, states and localities controlled all aspects of education, which led to rampant racial and economic disparities. Jim Crow laws had just ended 14 years prior, and many of the legacies of Jim Crow remained in tact. The federal government stepped in to ensure that education was not a privilege reserved for the wealthy and white, but a right guaranteed for all children. Sadly, much work remains in this space, and Trump is trying to undo the progress made. Another reminder that the "again" in MAGA refers to Jim Crow America.
Without a federal education department, the most vulnerable children--Black and brown students, disabled students, low-income students--will suffer the most.
For example, even now, a study by the non-profit org, EdBuild, found that white-majority school districts receive [$23 billion more in annual funding](https://substack.com/redirect/eb83da47-c525-420b-9ff2-7d71dab5422d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) than school districts serving mostly Black and brown students--even though they serve the same number of children. That gap is the result of a broken and discriminatory local funding system, which the DOE helps to correct through federal funding programs like Title I. If Trump succeeds in shutting down the DOE, this funding disparity will only grow, making it even more difficult for children in marginalized communities to receive the education they need and deserve. Trump's Executive Order will also impact enforcing Title IX protections, providing student loans, and ensuring Special Ed compliance.
So why is Trump pushing this? In part because he knows a uninformed populace is an easier to control populace. In part to pay for his $4.5T tax cut for his billionaire cronies. And in part because he wants to privatize education through the school voucher scam strategy, and in doing so, further enrich his billionaire friends. Remember, this is the same man who ran the scam Trump University, from which he was forced to pay a $25 million dollar fine for scamming students in a private online university. Trump has long bragged about how he "loves the poorly educated"--and now, he's making sure there are more of them.

## The Attack on Public Education is an Attack on Truth
This move also fits perfectly into the conservative push for book bans, censorship, and historical erasure. Without a DOE, states will have even more unchecked power to whitewash history, ban books about race and gender, and restrict discussions on topics like climate change and reproductive rights. This isn't just an education issue--it's an attack on knowledge itself.
We are already seeing what happens when schools are left to their own devices. A critical recent [report](https://substack.com/redirect/f361e0cb-702c-4031-a0b6-f925236f1d12?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by the Columbia Daily Spector provides a perfect example of this point. The Spector reports that just last week, the Department of Education's Office of Civil Rights opened an investigation into Columbia University following a complaint filed by Palestine Legal alleging a pattern of anti-Palestinian discrimination in violation of Title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964. This is now the third investigation the Department has opened into Columbia since November 2023.
A letter sent from the Department of Education to Palestine Legal attorneys confirmed that the department will investigate whether Columbia:
* Responded appropriately to alleged harassment
* Violated Title VI by engaging in disparate treatment
* Violated Title VI by engaging in retaliation against Palestinian affiliates

Trump has made no secret that he vehemently opposes pro-Palestine protests on college campuses. A quick reminder of his unhinged tweet posted earlier this week:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8b02dd1a-5858-4cf7-b06c-78b3680a81bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
We are already seeing an unprecedented level of book bans enforced by the MAGA cult. If the Department of Education ceases to exist, who will hold universities accountable for violating free speech and civil rights? Without this federal oversight, universities will be able to discriminate against students based on race, ethnicity, and political beliefs with zero repercussions.
This isn't free speech or freedom, this is fascism.
And it is designed to push Americans into school privatization via voucher programs to religious schools. With public education tax dollars now available for private school vouchers, right wing evangelicals can use public tax dollars to fund their private religious schools. They will nationalize the plan indoctrinate children using tax dollars, and exclude Black and brown children by denying them access to tax dollars. What started in the 1970s with Ronald Reagan ending funding for California's public universities to restrict the 'undesirable' Black, brown, and female student, is now coming to a head with Donald Trump ending federal funding for all public schools. Jim Crow never left America, and conservatives are trying to bring it back in full force with sanitized words like 'school choice.'

## Democrats Must Go Beyond Symbolic Gestures And Take (At Least) These 6 Steps
Trump's efforts to destroy public education demand serious opposition--not just Democrats dressing in pink and holding arts and crafts sessions at his next speech. We need a real strategy to protect education at all levels, including but not limited to these six acts:
1. Block Trump's EO through legal challenges. Democrats should have lawsuits filed in every Federal district and state court to block this defunding of public education. Bring out the students and teachers this defunding harms, and tell their story to the public. Be relentless in using the legal safeguards still available to us to our advantage.
2. Mobilize local and state governments to uphold education standards. Every Democratic Governor should join these lawsuits, and allocate additional state funding to ensure children in the children in their states have their needs met. State Attorneys general should also be filing lawsuits against the Federal government to slow down this degradation and demand accountability.
3. Demand Congress safeguard the DOE's role in protecting civil rights and funding equity. Contact every member of Congress and demand they block attempts to defund education. Then contact them again. Then again. Light those phones up.
4. Members of the House and Senate should deny quorum on future votes. Deny unanimous consent. Deny cloture. Conduct sit ins. Bring government to a crawl and make Republicans own their failure. Even now, Republicans are asking Elon Musk for permission to vote ([yes, really](https://substack.com/redirect/2369ae83-7435-48eb-81ba-6905f00007a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)). So much for Trump's claim that we will "no longer be accountable to unelected bureaucrats." And I would say Democrats should raise their voice, but they might turn on each other and censure each other as they did to Rep Al Green (TX) for daring to speak out against Trump's attempts to gut Medicaid. Bottom line, give Republicans no leeway.
5. Tell the story effectively with your best story tellers. Unleash Rep Crockett, Rep AOC, Rep Raskin, Rep Pressley, Senator Sanders, Senator Warnock, and Senator Hayes. Go on a national media tour and bombard the airwaves with accurate information on how gutting the DOE will harm our children, our teachers, and our public schools. Why can Trump so effectively use a 13-year-old child to push his propaganda narrative but we cannot elevate actual stories of children suffering under Trump's policies?
6. Win the messaging game by investing in content creators to tell this story and let the American public know. Pew [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/e9452364-9b2f-46a4-9dc1-83d83ecc4b55?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that at least 54% of Americans get their news at least sometimes from social media. Republicans invested heavily in social media content creators during the 2024 election, and it paid off big for them. Democrats need to invest tens of millions, if not hundreds of millions, of dollars in content creators to win the public narrative on this crisis. It is an unforced error to not invest massive resources in the content creators putting out accurate content to stop the advancement of fascism in the United States.

In short, this isn't just another one of Trump's empty promises--it's a calculated attack on the very foundation of an informed society. We cannot afford to sit back and watch. The fight for education is a fight for democracy itself. Democrats can adopt all six of the above, and several more strategies, to block Trump's anti-education plan from advancing.
**I am doing everything in my power to stave off fascism under this new administration. I cannot do it alone. Subscribe below and join the movement.**

Democrats Must Go Beyond Symbolic Gestures And Take (At Least) These 6 Steps Trump's efforts to destroy public education demand serious opposition--not just Democrats dressing in pink and holding arts and crafts sessions at his next speech. We need a real strategy to protect education at all levels, including but not limited to these six acts: 1. Block Trump's EO through legal challenges. Democrats should have lawsuits filed in every Federal district and state court to block this defunding of public education. Bring out the students and teachers this defunding harms, and tell their story to the public. Be relentless in using the legal safeguards still available to us to our advantage. 2. Mobilize local and state governments to uphold education standards. Every Democratic Governor should join these lawsuits, and allocate additional state funding to ensure children in the children in their states have their needs met. State Attorneys general should also be filing lawsuits against the Federal government to slow down this degradation and demand accountability. 3. Demand Congress safeguard the DOE's role in protecting civil rights and funding equity. Contact every member of Congress and demand they block attempts to defund education. Then contact them again. Then again. Light those phones up. 4. Members of the House and Senate should deny quorum on future votes. Deny unanimous consent. Deny cloture. Conduct sit ins. Bring government to a crawl and make Republicans own their failure. Even now, Republicans are asking Elon Musk for permission to vote (). So much for Trump's claim that we will "no longer be accountable to unelected bureaucrats." And I would say Democrats should raise their voice, but they might turn on each other and censure each other as they did to Rep Al Green (TX) for daring to speak out against Trump's attempts to gut Medicaid. Bottom line, give Republicans no leeway. 5. Tell the story effectively with your best story tellers. Unleash Rep Crockett, Rep AOC, Rep Raskin, Rep Pressley, Senator Sanders, Senator Warnock, and Senator Hayes. Go on a national media tour and bombard the airwaves with accurate information on how gutting the DOE will harm our children, our teachers, and our public schools. Why can Trump so effectively use a 13-year-old child to push his propaganda narrative but we cannot elevate actual stories of children suffering under Trump's policies? 6. Win the messaging game by investing in content creators to tell this story and let the American public know. Pew that at least 54% of Americans get their news at least sometimes from social media. Republicans invested heavily in social media content creators during the 2024 election, and it paid off big for them. Democrats need to invest tens of millions, if not hundreds of millions, of dollars in content creators to win the public narrative on this crisis. It is an unforced error to not invest massive resources in the content creators putting out accurate content to stop the advancement of fascism in the United States. In short, this isn't just another one of Trump's empty promises--it's a calculated attack on the very foundation of an informed society. We cannot afford to sit back and watch. The fight for education is a fight for democracy itself. Democrats can adopt all six of the above, and several more strategies, to block Trump's anti-education plan from advancing. I am doing everything in my power to stave off fascism under this new administration. I cannot do it alone. Subscribe below and join the movement. | | ---|---|--- Quick Ask! I am doing everything in my power over the next four years to stave off fascism in the United States, and I need your support.Become a paid subscriber and join the movement. | | | | | | | (C) 2025 Qasim Rashid, Esq. 1552 South Route 59 #1333 Naperville, IL 60564 ? ?

These cuts would be devastating.

Hello,
I’m Gay Valimont, and I’m running for office because it’s time to hold corporations and politicians accountable for putting profits over people.
Fossil fuel companies spent a record $96 million to back Trump’s reelection , securing policies that gut environmental protections and put our future at risk. The GOP shut down investigations into industry corruption, letting Big Oil continue misleading the public while pushing for deregulation.
This is not leadership—it’s selling out our communities, and in 25 short days we need to gather the support we need to fight back. Will you join us, before our national parks, beaches, and lakes look like this:

✅ Holding Big Oil Accountable – We need real oversight to stop disinformation and ensure the industry pays for the damage it causes.
✅ Investing in Clean Energy – We must transition to renewable energy sources that create jobs, lower costs, and protect our environment.

Trump’s hand-picked Supreme Court judges gutted a key component of the Clean Water Act and stripped the EPA of its power to enforce critical protections for our waterways.
This decision is exactly what Big Oil and polluters wanted.
**Here’s what happened and why it matters:**
* The Court ruled in favor of San Francisco, saying the EPA’s permit system was too vague to enforce against wastewater pollution. That means cities and industries now have more leeway to pollute rivers, lakes, and coastlines without clear consequences.

* The Clean Water Act was created because of public outrage over toxic pollution in rivers like the Hudson. In 1972, Congress gave the EPA power to regulate wastewater and hold polluters accountable — leading to cleaner water across the country. This ruling could roll back decades of progress.

* Polluters are celebrating, because this ruling opens the door for even more legal challenges to environmental laws — weakening climate protections at a time when we should be strengthening them.

* This decision goes beyond major cities. It erodes protections for small towns and rural communities that rely on clean water for drinking and agriculture. The burden of pollution will hit these communities the hardest.

| Peter,

As we begin Women’s History Month, we come together to reflect on the remarkable women who have shaped our past and continue to inspire us today. From trailblazing activists to everyday leaders, women have been at the heart of Virginia’s history, breaking barriers, working toward justice, and paving the way for generations after them.

However, as we celebrate our achievements, we must also acknowledge that our work for women’s rights and equality is far from over.

In states across the country, lawmakers have turned back the clocks on women’s rights – stripping them of bodily autonomy and enacting laws to punish women for seeking reproductive healthcare. I never imagined a world in which my three daughters would grow up having less bodily autonomy than I had.

Virginia is the only state in the South that hasn’t rolled back restrictions on reproductive freedom after the _Dobbs_ decision. As Governor, I will not allow Virginia to go backward – I will work every day to protect women’s reproductive healthcare.

**But we still have a long way to go. Together, we can build a future where every woman has the freedom, opportunity, and support she deserves — and I hope you will join me in this campaign.**

clean_body: As we begin Women’s History Month, we come together to reflect on the remarkable women who have shaped our past and continue to inspire us today. | = | Peter, As we begin Women’s History Month, we come together to reflect on the remarkable women who have shaped our past and continue to inspire us today. From trailblazing activists to everyday leaders, women have been at the heart of Virginia’s history, breaking barriers, working toward justice, and paving the way for generations after them. However, as we celebrate our achievements, we must also acknowledge that our work for women’s rights and equality is far from over. In states across the country, lawmakers have turned back the clocks on women’s rights – stripping them of bodily autonomy and enacting laws to punish women for seeking reproductive healthcare. I never imagined a world in which my three daughters would grow up having less bodily autonomy than I had. Virginia is the only state in the South that hasn’t rolled back restrictions on reproductive freedom after the Dobbs decision. As Governor, I will not allow Virginia to go backward – I will work every day to protect women’s reproductive healthcare. But we still have a long way to go. Together, we can build a future where every woman has the freedom, opportunity, and support she deserves — and I hope you will join me in this campaign. | = Thank you, Abigail Spanberger * | | Paid for by Spanberger for Governor Spanberger for Governor P.O. Hi everyone. Senator Elissa Slotkin here.

I gave the official response to President Trump’s Joint Address this week. I hope you had a chance to watch.

Since I’m a stranger to most people who don’t follow politics, I introduced myself and just kept it straight with the people watching about the moment we are in right now.

We just went through another fraught election season. Americans made it clear that they want change. But there is a responsible way to make change, and a reckless way. And, we can make that change without forgetting who we are as a country, and as a democracy.

Because no matter where you live, most Americans share three core beliefs: That the middle class is the engine of our country. That strong national security protects us from harm. And that our democracy, no matter how messy, is unparalleled and worth fighting for.

We all know that our country is going through something right now. We’re not sure what the next day is going to hold, let alone the next decade.

But this isn’t the first time we’ve experienced this as a country. Every single time, we’ve gotten through those moments because of two things: Engaged citizens and principled leaders.

If you're with me in that fight, I have an ask of you:

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

With the ongoing ceasefire deal between Israel and Gaza consistently
violated and delayed by the Israeli government, last weekend Benjamin
Netanyahu announced that Israel is stopping the entry of ALL food and
supplies into Gaza – a blatant war crime.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250306?refcode=em20250306-36482&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36482_1203867_W5zVSO&akid=36482%2E1203867%2EW5zVSO ]A post on X from the Associated Press reading: 'BREAKING: Israel says
it is stopping the entry of all goods and supplies into Gaza.' The post
contains a map of Israel, Gaza, and the West Bank.

Remember: Israel has already used mass starvation as a tool in their
genocidal war against Palestine. The International Criminal Court issued
arrest warrants for Netanyahu and former Defense Minister Yoav Gallant
last November over their use of starvation throughout the conflict.

This aid blockage comes after the Israeli military has already violated
the ceasefire countless times, including a recent shelling near Khan
Younis that killed 5 Palestinians and injured 21 others.

And they don’t plan on stopping there: Israel’s Finance Minister Bezalel
Smotrich said, “The next phase includes cutting off electricity and water
and resuming fighting to advance Trump’s plan” and “opening the gates of
hell on Gaza with a powerful, deadly and quick attack.”

This is not a genuine attempt at achieving peace and returning the
hostages, but clear and intentional ethnic cleansing — and the Trump
administration is fully backing it for the chance to occupy some or all of
the Gaza Strip in partnership with Netanyahu.

Justice Democrats is proud to support progressive champions like Reps.
Rashida Tlaib, Summer Lee, Delia Ramirez and many others who have
consistently and bravely stood up for Palestinians’ human rights. But we
desperately need more Democrats in Congress who will speak out against
this genocide and do something to end it.

to help us find, support, and elect the next generation of Congress
members who will support peace and justice ASAP?

Justice Democrats

**Arizona lawmakers are trying to ram through a bill that could jeopardize fair maps, fair representation, and the fair distribution of resources around the state.**
Here’s what you need to know, Peter: The proposed legislation would propose a constitutional amendment to create a separate census for Arizona that could undercount immigrant communities and communities of color — giving them _less_ representation in the halls of power and _less_ access to critical funding.
**This bill has already passed the state senate and could come up for a vote in the state house soon.**
All On The Line is mobilizing Arizonans against this bill, but defeating this kind of anti-voter attack — and making sure this type of playbook cannot be replicated across the country — requires strong grassroots support.

If passed, this plan would force Arizona to conduct its own census every decade that explicitly excludes non-citizens, instead of relying on the existing federal census, like every other state has done for nearly a century, as the U.S. Constitution requires a federal census.
Many problems could come up with requiring a separate census, including:
• Taxpayers might have to cover a potential price tag of around $300 million.
• If Arizonans are asked to fill out a new state census, they might think they don’t need to complete the federal version around that same time. That could lead to the state having less representation in Congress, fewer votes in the Electoral College, and reduced federal funding.
• Arizonans might avoid filling in the state version because of the citizenship question or because the new census doesn’t have clear privacy protections. And low response rates could make the data useless or wildly unrepresentative.
**Ultimately, by targeting people who aren’t citizens, this legislation is designed to create fear and division — threatening fair representation, critical funding, and the well-being of Arizona communities.**

Peter,
When we first heard about COVID-19, we were terrified. The news was dominated by talk of mass casualties, limited hospital rooms, and unending isolation. We became traumatized and hopeless, thinking, “ _Is this the new normal?_ ” My name is Brianne Dressen, and I am honored to collaborate with Texans for Vaccine Choice as we expose the wrongdoings of corrupt pharmaceutical companies during the COVID-19 vaccine trials. Like so many others, when I heard about the COVID-19 vaccine, it sounded like a cure for all our problems. By participating in the vaccine trial, I believed I could help heal our country.
You might already know my story, how the vaccine left me in crippling pain, wondering if I would live to see my children grow up or ever see a day without physical agony. My story didn’t end there, and there’s so much more to tell, just like so many others. Today’s story is different. It’s a story about a very special friend of mine, Maddie de Garay. When Maddie was 12, she volunteered to participate in the Pfizer vaccine trials, believing, like I did, that she could help our country heal.

|
---
| [ ](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/tb/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTQ4MTY0MDA0ODg2MzQ5NTAxLFwiclwiOjE0ODE2NDAzNDA5NTQ4MjQxMH0iLCJzIjoiNWQ1YWRmOTRhZTMwZmRjMyJ9)
---
|
---
However, when Maddie began having seizures, excruciating pain, and mobility issues, the de Garays and their once-healthy daughter were **abandoned** by pharmaceutical companies and doctors. Maddie, who was confined to a wheelchair, was an inconvenient casualty. Maddie was not alone, though. Through our search for answers, we found each other – and thousands of other victims – suffering from the same debilitating symptoms. Maddie bravely shares her heartbreaking story in the film [_Follow the Silenced_](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/tb/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTQ4MTY0MDA0ODkwNTQzODA3LFwiclwiOjE0ODE2NDAzNDA5NTQ4MjQxMH0iLCJzIjoiOWU2MzZkNjhhMmRjNzc1ZCJ9) _._ Because of Maddie and many other victims who courageously fought to reveal the truth, we founded **React19** , the first nonprofit dedicated to helping the vaccine injured. We fight every day to help Maddie and countless others get their lives back and find a way to heal from vaccine injuries, and you can help us!

|
---
| | [ **Fight for the Vaccine Injured!** ](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/tb/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTQ4MTY0MDA0ODk0NzM4MTE0LFwiclwiOjE0ODE2NDAzNDA5NTQ4MjQxMH0iLCJzIjoiNzE0NGQ1Yjk3YWNiNTY3MSJ9)
---
|
---
We want to honor heroes like Maddie by covering their travel expenses to the special _**Follow the Silenced**_ movie screening on March 15 at the Santa Monica Film Festival in Los Angeles. Without their voices, we would not know the true dangers of the COVID jabs. We can never repair all that was broken by the lies and corruption, but we can honor our friends who get up daily to fight this battle.
[Help Texans for Vaccine Choice raise funds to cover the travel expenses of the courageous vaccine injury victims. Join us as we properly honor them at this groundbreaking movie premiere.](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/tb/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTQ4MTY0MDA0ODk4OTMyNDIxLFwiclwiOjE0ODE2NDAzNDA5NTQ4MjQxMH0iLCJzIjoiYmJiY2Q4NmMxMzRlZWNiYSJ9)

subject: RITE PAC WINS IN ARIZONA COURT OF APPEALS
body:
Arizona officials cannot unilaterally impose unlawful election rules that undermine public confidence |

| | **RITE PAC WINS IN ARIZONA COURT OF APPEALS IN CHALLENGE TO STATE ELECTION PROCEDURES MANUAL ** **Secretary of State Fontes Violated State Transparency Law When Issuing Manual ** (Phoenix, AZ – March 6, 2025) – Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections PAC (“RITE PAC”), an organization dedicated to protecting election integrity, secured a major victory today to ensure that Arizona officials cannot unilaterally impose unlawful election rules that undermine public confidence in elections. The Arizona Court of Appeals [unanimously](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=4f4c257b0f&e=ea91f782ea) agreed with RITE PAC that Arizona Secretary of State Adrian Fontes violated the law when he adopted Arizona’s 2023 Elections Procedures Manual (EPM). The ruling ensures that Arizona election officials will follow the rulemaking procedures set forth in law when they make changes to how the state conducts its elections. In this case, RITE PAC supported the Arizona GOP and the Yavapai County Republican Party to challenge the 2023 EPM. Upon publishing it, Secretary Fontes took to X to [dare](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=2a510fd790&e=ea91f782ea) his opponents to sue him. The RNC, Arizona GOP, and Yavapai County Republicans did just that, arguing that in his rush to impose his illegal, partisan policy preferences on Arizona voters, Secretary Fontes had violated the law by depriving them of their statutory right to review and comment upon the EPM. Today, the court agreed that Secretary Fontes broke the law. The unlawfully promulgated EPM contained several provisions that weakened key safeguards against fraud and errors in voter registration and ballot security, including rules that unlawfully allowed federal-only voters without proof of citizenship to vote in presidential elections and by mail, prohibited challenges to early ballots before they were returned, and prevented county recorders from using national databases to verify citizenship. “This decision is a significant win for election integrity and the rule of law,” said RITE PAC’s President & CEO Derek Lyons. “Arizona’s Secretary of State believed he was not bound by Arizona law. We were happy to respond to his invitation to sue him and grateful for the appellate court’s decision showing him just how wrong he was. Today’s ruling reaffirms that Arizona’s election officials must follow the law and cannot rewrite election procedures without public input.”
###

"Linda McMahon has now been tasked to eliminate the Department of Education. Special Ed. is about to get slashed," Phillips claimed. "Senator, I know you have a son with special needs, I grew up in a family with siblings that have special needs. What do you say to parents who are really scared about their kids' futures?!"
**[Schmitt fired back,](https://substack.com/redirect/e757c390-781a-4fca-b1c0-5d203f818b59?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** "Yeah I guess my message would be don't believe media reports like you're promoting right now. It's not true. That funding is going to continue to flow. But what you won't see is the DOE denying grant applications to school districts across this country because they haven't implemented divisive DEI training, trying to divide the room by race!"
The senator continued, "So I think a little bit of truthfulness here as opposed to scaring the daylights out of folks who are in vulnerable positions would be appropriate!"
"Well I think a lot of people are scared right now, they are losing jobs, losing their resources-" Phillips answered back.
Schmitt snapped, "Well if they watch your report about it, they might be! **[But the facts just don't support that!"](https://substack.com/redirect/e757c390-781a-4fca-b1c0-5d203f818b59?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

# **MAGA Byron Donalds smashes sanctuary city mayor for ignorance on illegal immigration**
**\- By Richie McGinniss**
Rep Byron Donalds (R-FL) **[took Democrat mayors to the tool shed](https://substack.com/redirect/64bad715-b063-4dc4-b168-3512a82cf812?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and hammered their reckless policies on illegal immigration, during a House Oversight Committee hearing on Sanctuary Cities.
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/64bad715-b063-4dc4-b168-3512a82cf812?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/64bad715-b063-4dc4-b168-3512a82cf812?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Boston Mayor Michelle Wu was especially defiant, but Donalds exposed her ignorance when he asked her how much the city spent on illegal immigration and she replied, "we don't have that number."
Donalds snapped back with a question that has been on many Americans' minds since former President Joe Biden took office in 2021, "Are you out of your mind?"
This hearing took place as the Trump administration **[clamps down on illegal immigration](https://substack.com/redirect/64bad715-b063-4dc4-b168-3512a82cf812?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , and sanctuary cities continue to defy federal enforcement of America's immigration.
If this exchange was any indicator, the next few months will bring more clashes between DC Republicans trying to fulfill Trump's campaign promise to solve America's immigration crisis, and Democrat mayors who try to oppose the MAGA agenda at every turn.
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/64bad715-b063-4dc4-b168-3512a82cf812?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
# **Texas Patriot exposes corrupt sanctuary city mayor**
**\- By Richie McGinniss**
Texas Rep. Brandon Gil **[called out Chicago Mayor Brandon Johnson](https://substack.com/redirect/8471e035-5a02-4875-80e9-b56ea8c57e4a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** over his federal law-defying sanctuary city policies and a number of highly questionable luxury items that his office received as gifts, during a House Oversight Committee hearing.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/8471e035-5a02-4875-80e9-b56ea8c57e4a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
In addition to probing questions on Chicago's immigration policies, the Congressman asked about specific eye-brow-raising items that were given to the Mayor's office, "You received Hugo Boss cufflinks and a personalized Monte Blanc pen. Do you know who gave you those?"
"So I did not receive those personally, the City of Chicago received them." The Mayor responded.
**["You received a Gucci tote bag, do you know who gave you that?!"](https://substack.com/redirect/8471e035-5a02-4875-80e9-b56ea8c57e4a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Gil pressed further, then correcting himself, "gave the city of Chicago that?"
Johnson again refused to provide a yes or no answer.
"This raises serious ethical concerns!," Gil snapped. "You're providing an enormous amount of aid to illegal aliens,... and you yourself are receiving an enormous amount of gifts and you won't even tell us who they're coming from!!"
How a city of millions of people can receive a personalized luxury pen or designer cufflinks aside, this exchange shows the extent to which Democratic politicians have worried much more about signaling their virtue rather than tending to the real concerns and needs of the citizens they represent.
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/8471e035-5a02-4875-80e9-b56ea8c57e4a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

The numbers don't lie and both of the woke media outlets reported that 76% of Americans approved of the president's speech Tuesday night. President Trump is expected to sign an executive order today to abolish the department of education. For the past 40 years or so the department's cost seem to steadily rise while math, reading and science scores either stay the same or drop. It is ineffective and should be sent back to the state level. The radicals are furious that DOGE has taken on USAID – and it’s no mystery why. For years this bloated agency and the Biden State Department have funneled your tax dollars into left-wing nonsense like:
---
* **$1.5 million** for DEI in Serbian workplaces
* **$70,000** for a DEI musical in Ireland
* **$47,000** for a transgender opera in Colombia
* **$32,000** for a transgender comic in Peru
* **$37 million** to the World Health Organization
* **$16 million** for gender development contractors
* **$4 million** for a Center for Climate-Positive Development

body:
| | Peter, I wanted to share my thoughts with you following Tuesday night’s joint session address.

The reality is that folks across WA-03, and across the country, are facing challenges – whether it’s the costs of groceries and childcare that remain too high, or struggling to run a family farm or small business.

The way to address these challenges is not by fostering hyperpartisanship or extremism, nor is it by executive action and resulting litigation. What we need now more than ever is good-faith efforts to find common ground, and meaningful bipartisan work by Congress.

I’ve heard from you at home in the district, and in our online outreach: above all, our communities want the petty political fights to end, and they want leaders who stand up for our democratic institutions and get things done.

That’s what I’ve always done, and that’s what I’ll continue to do, Peter.

We have a lot of work ahead of us. From preventing a government shutdown, to supporting Ukraine, expanding opportunities in skilled trades, bringing down the costs of energy and housing, and more – my priorities remain clear.

I’m grateful to have you on our team as we keep forging ahead.

– Marie

Renowned cardiothoracic surgeon Dr. Steven Gundry has found an invisible problem affecting almost everything we eat. But almost nobody knows it's happening except the big food companies responsible for it.

And Dr. Gundry's research shows it could be the true cause of low energy, digestive issues, and unwanted weight gain in millions of Americans over 35.

But that's not even the worst part.

Because this problem has flown under the radar for decades, there are no rules to protect us. Nobody is stopping these companies from doing this to our food, says Dr. Gundry.

He exposes exactly what's happening and what you can do about it in a **[new whistleblowing video report that reveals his shocking research.](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8zs1ywiAQwPGnITczsEtADxzaOrEzfkxrL_VIgBhqaGKIUt--E8fxuvub_a8OfevrmyLylQA03kYCQPCFAJwPKQyXn7BezT6OYTc7i10opi28PegVnvjX6K7bfh0-8X0T1_uDOf3t05U9-Xjr3RM_orkL2rfTVC4zq7C2lGdOMckZUgQpskZZaWu0RnDQjlpt5oxDgdxQt7BO1JB5BRQKilQAAqMyr1FUWpg5M5WDeVETTu-dXAc3eKNZHJMehq4LuelC1qpmHPt4f6wkUKaU8qoJttUnd5sEgbLcffM9I1DiVqw2bDFJLOOlYgSXgjGeDcr2ybetj0ISTo_34HT-quA_AAD__z9faOk)**

**Once you've seen this, Dr. Gundry says, you'll never buy groceries the same way again.**

In his free video, Dr. Gundry reveals a new method for protecting yourself and your family from this little-known problem affecting food all across America.

It's a technique he's been using himself and at age 74, he says it's the reason he looks and feels decades younger.

The video has quickly gone viral, with thousands of people saying they've been using Dr. Gundry's simple discovery at breakfast every day.

And as a result, they report having more energy, improved digestion, more comfortable joints, and a slimmer waistline.

Dr. Gundry has granted permission for us to share the full video below, completely free.

So if we stop the Early Vote Erosion Act (House Bill 397) by tonight, we could keep it from becoming law this year. name: The Democrats
subject: Update: DNC sues Donald Trump
body:
We know there’s a lot of news happening right now, so we wanted to make sure you didn't miss this:
---
**_DNC Sues Trump Over Illegal Executive Order Threatening Free and Fair Elections_** We know there’s a lot of news happening right now, so we wanted to make sure you didn't miss this, Derek. Two weeks ago, Trump signed an executive order claiming that he gets to decide how independent agencies like the Federal Election Commission (FEC) interpret the law. The FEC, which Congress created after Watergate to regulate how money is raised and spent in federal elections, was designed to be bipartisan and insulated from the political whims of the White House. In this country, we are guaranteed fair elections with impartial referees — not a system where Trump can hand down his preferred campaign rules from his perch in the White House. This executive order is a grave threat to this guarantee. **The DNC is fighting back. Alongside the DCCC and DSCC, we’ve filed a lawsuit against Trump to stop his hostile takeover of the FEC.** For the future of our democracy, it’s absolutely critical that we not cede the institutions that safeguard our elections to Trump and his MAGA Republican allies. That means using every tool at our disposal — including aggressively confronting Trump’s illegal actions in the courts — to defend voters’ right to free and fair elections. Thank you again for your support as we fight back against Trump to protect our democracy. Thank you, The Democrats **Your support helps us continue to build a strong Democratic Party that can protect voters, fight back against Trump’s illegal plans, and elect Democrats up and down the ballot who will fight for our democracy.** [**If this work is important to you, too, we hope you’ll consider chipping in $3 to help fund it:**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-march-2025?amount=3&refcode=em_20250306_2909_fr&refcode2=2909_22930333_Kjxk2M&akid=2909%2E22930333%2EKjxk2M) **[CONTRIBUTE $3](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-march-2025?refcode=em_20250306_2909_fr&amount=3&refcode2=2909_22930333_Kjxk2M&akid=2909%2E22930333%2EKjxk2M)**
